items.titleEn: Kelley Few: Local Legend to Akers' Arsenal
items.summaryEn: Few's football career accelerated rapidly after she left Romford Ladies for Arsenal in 1990
bodyEn: There aren’t many players better placed to explain Arsenal’s ascension to domestic dominance than Kelley Few.

An extremely accomplished and determined centre half who was equally capable of playing at left back, Few joined the club in 1990 and was a mainstay of an Arsenal side that would become the dominant force in women’s football in England.

“I didn’t have an ounce of flair in me,” she laughs now, “but I got the job done.” To say the least. Her journey to Arsenal was as uncomplicated as her playing style, but no less demanding. She went from playing in her neighbourhood in Romford to Romford Ladies to Arsenal with few diversions.

“I grew up with two older brothers and I played with them,” she says. “I lived on a street where there was only one other girl. I was playing football with my brothers and all the other kids on our street all the time. “I got bigger and better and stronger; they used to whack the ball at me for fun. I was always doing sport at school, especially tennis and hockey, but football wasn’t on the school curriculum.”

Sport-mad Few opted for football. In an era when women’s teams were few (sorry!) and far between, Kelley found a team essentially on her Essex doorstep: “Just by chance there was a local team called Romford Ladies. I joined them at the age of 16 and went straight into adult women’s football. That’s where it all began. I played for them for a couple of years until I joined Arsenal in 1990.”

Kelley had barely played structured 11-a-side football by the time she got to Romford, but she says her qualities were easy to appreciate. “I took what I knew from playing in the streets to Romford. My brothers played in youth clubs and for local teams and I would go along and kick a ball about. I would play tennis when I was a teenager, but I just went to Romford and was immediately up against women in their twenties and thirties.”

Junior teams for girls simply did not exist in the 1980s. “It was straight in at the deep end but there was a lot of camaraderie, and the older players would look after you. But I hadn’t really been coached about methods of play, so I just adapted. There was probably less pressure. We turned up for fun and loved what we did.

"My strengths were tackling and heading. I wasn’t exceptionally fast but I read the game well I was a good team player. I got the job done. There was no flair whatsoever. I could kick with both feet so I could play left and right.”

Few often played in midfield for Romford. “When I went to Arsenal, Vic Akers probably identified that I was more of a defender. So I played mainly centre back or left back. I would win the ball and just give it to the people in front of me.”

Modestly, Kelley admits that the opportunity to play for Arsenal came by chance, albeit Arsenal Women were only three years into their existence at the time and had not yet established themselves as a women’s football powerhouse: “When I was at Romford, my manager John Greenacre was heavily involved in London and Essex football, so I played in some inter regional games and tournaments and it was counties selecting players to go and play.

“I was part of the either London or Essex squad, I can’t remember which! I met people like [former Gunners] Michelle Curley and Kirsty Pealling and Vicki Slee. I chatted to them, and John Greenacre and Vic Akers had a football relationship. Vic asked me to go to the JVC Centre to train with Arsenal and it went from there. I turned up and I had nothing to lose.

“Arsenal had only existed for a few years but it was still a big jump to go from Romford Ladies to Arsenal. It was the up and coming club. I trained few times, was asked to stay and the rest is history. It was by chance.”

In 1990, Arsenal Ladies were clearly upwardly mobile but were playing in the second tier. By 1993, they would win the domestic treble. Did Kelley have a notion of how dominant Arsenal would become? “No. I don’t think any of us did. We got promoted to the top flight in 1991/92 and then players started joining like Debbie Bampton, Maria Luckhurst, Marieanne Spacey. We had players like Naz Ball and Sian Williams already. Angie Banks signed for us and it just got bigger and bigger.”

Few explains that manager Akers built a starless culture built on hard work and humility: “We were all treated equally. We all turned up and did the job. We all had to train, we all had to turn up and no one got special treatment. Our fitness and our strength was our strength. We played together year in, year out. But quickly we won a treble, another double – I won a hell of a lot of trophies!

“We all wanted the same thing and no one was invincible. You had to work to keep your place. Vic instilled this camaraderie and belief of who we were and who we were representing. We weren’t officially professional but we behaved like we were.”

Few says that sense of professionalism and competition for places drove the team to always go the extra mile. “Once in the early 1990s we trained on Boxing Day. We wanted to be there because we had an important FA Cup game in early January. No one else would have been doing that. Our fitness levels won us a lot of games. We weren’t always the most technical side, but our fitness and our depth was second to none. Our positions were all there to be won.”
Like all players from her era, Few balanced training, playing and competing at this elite level while holding down a full-time job.

“I was a supervisor with America Express business travel, so I held down a full-time office job from Monday to Friday. My employers knew I was playing football; they would let me work my lunch and leave at 4pm to get to training or get on a coach to play an away game. I’d get home at 2am and I would still be back in the next day.

“We trained a couple of times a week, but as we became more successful we were training three times a week. I manipulated my work around training. It was hard mentally and physically, but you did it because you knew your team-mates were doing it too and being part of that team ethos kept you going.”

Undoubtedly Few’s finest individual moment arrived in the 1998 FA Cup final. A rollercoaster final against an excellent Croydon side featuring the likes of Hope Powell was tied at 2-2 in stoppage time when Few came forward for a set piece. She scored a last-gasp winner to win the cup, and Kelley explains that the moment had greater significance than many realised.

“I had a bad car accident in France in 1997 and I didn’t play for a couple of months. Around Christmas time, Vic gave me a pep talk and asked me to come back to training. The euphoria of scoring a winning goal late in a cup final was enough, but there was a bit extra. I got back into the game, I was still able to do it and that meant so much. We beat a great Croydon team but I was happy to still be there and playing.

“It wasn’t the prettiest goal – I only ever went up for corners and free kicks. I think Faye White had a shot touched on to the crossbar and I hit the biggest ‘shinner’ I ever hit in my life, but it went in. People still remind me of that goal and show me pictures every now and then.” Having represented the Gunners from 1990 until 2003, Few was well positioned to see young talent like Rachel Yankey and Kelly Smith emerge.

“I could see those two had this immense talent, and when I came to the end I could see all these great players like Jayne Ludlow. At the turn of the century, the game was getting bigger, a bit more coverage and media, and it was moving on.

“I look at players like Kelly, Rachel and Jayne and appreciate so much what they achieved afterwards. It’s not enough to be talented. You have to keep producing otherwise there is no legacy – and they kept producing.” The emergence of a new crop of talent made Kelley consider her future in an era where there were no real financial rewards for being a women’s footballer.

“In 2001 I was coming up to 30. Players go on for longer now but they have strength and conditioning coaches, which we didn’t have. Don’t get me wrong, we had a lot – Arsène Wenger came in, David Dein vouched for us and Vic was close to them. We were privileged because we had physios and a training ground, and we stayed in hotels before away games. Other teams didn’t have that. We were very well looked after.

“But I had a full-time job. We didn’t get paid much, but we made friendships and we travelled and we won so much together. But you get to 30 and you’re a bit tired when you get to training and in the evening. The likes of Lianne Sanderson, Anita Asante and Alex Scott were coming through, and these younger players, they will take your place. Just like I came in and took the place of someone like Gill Wylie.

“I got to a point in 2001 where we had just got into the Champions League. We played in Switzerland and I was part of the squad, but I wasn’t really playing. I was on the bench. I could see this team was going to get bigger and better and move even quicker and, however much I wanted to be a part of that, I wanted to go out at the top. I wanted to go on my terms and at a level that I was happy with.”
Few slowly began to transition into more of a coaching role at Arsenal before retiring from playing in 2003 and coaching full time.

“I started to help coaching the reserve team, so I became assistant manager. Girls’ academies and centres of excellence started to pop up from the FA. So I got involved with Clare Wheatley and did my coaching badges. I didn’t completely leave. I did the next best thing to playing, which was teaching and passing on from the Under-10s to the Under-18s.

“I had that transition of getting youngsters coming through. Some of them are still at the club and if I gave a snippet of insight to them I can be proud of that. I used to coach Leah Williamson in the Under-10s and Under-12s and she still recognises me at games. But there were players before her like Lianne Sanderson, Becky Spencer and Gilly Flaherty. I coached Alex Scott in the reserves a little. That, to me, is like another trophy.”

Few left the club fully in 2008 following the death of her mother, which she says made her want to work in a manner that allowed her to spend more time with her father: “I was self-employed because I had my badges, so I worked with Camden Council and I loved that, but it was long hours and I wanted to look after my dad.

“I went back into business travel. I still followed the game and went to matches. I have a lot of great friends I am still in touch with like Kirsty Pealling, Emma Byrne, Leanne Champ and Emma Hayes. I still follow the game and I carried on with my own fitness. I watched football as a spectator; I have younger family who play. My nephew, Sam, works as a press officer for Chelsea Women.”
Few explains that Arsenal and England establishing firmer alumni initiatives in recent years has brought her back closer to women’s football again.

“In 2017, for the 30th anniversary of Arsenal Women I met a lot of ex-players again and got involved with the Arsenal alumni. It got me back in touch with people like Angie Banks, Sian Williams, Michelle Curley, Kirsty Pealling and Clare Wheatley. It gave me that spark for the game again and that recognition that what I had done was recognised.”

Kelley still attends Arsenal and England games when she can: “I moved to Devon in 2018 for a quieter life! I still follow it on TV and it’s all been getting more professional. The Lionesses have also been in touch and lots of former players got their legacy caps. In 2022 I got my legacy cap and it was fantastic to be recognised. That sparked something inside me again. I always get to matches when I am back in London: Arsenal and Lionesses.”

Few admits that the elite women’s game is worlds away from where it was during her time as a player and as a coach. She won five top flight league titles, five FA Cups, and seven League Cups. It was an era where she was barely paid but Kelley has no regrets. “I am so happy with what I won, how I won it, the people I met and the memories. I wouldn’t change any of it for the world.”

items.titleZh: 凯利·菲尔：从本土传奇到阿克斯麾下的阿森纳功臣
items.summaryZh: 凯利·菲尔回忆了自己1990年加入阿森纳并开启辉煌女足生涯的经历。
bodyZh: 没有多少球员比凯利·菲尔更能解释阿森纳在英格兰国内足坛走向统治地位的过程了。
菲尔是一位极具成就和决心的中后卫，也能胜任左后卫。她于1990年加入阿森纳，并成为这支日后统治英格兰女足的球队的中流砥柱。
她现在笑着说：“我身上没有半点花哨的技术，但我能完成任务。”至少可以这么说。她加盟阿森纳的历程和她的球风一样简单明了，但也同样充满挑战。她从罗姆福德的社区踢球开始，先后效力于罗姆福德女足和阿森纳，没有经历太多的波折。
她说：“我和两个哥哥一起长大，我跟他们一起踢球。我住的那条街上只有另一个女孩。我一直在和哥哥们以及街上的其他孩子们踢球。我的个子长高了，球技更好了，身体也更强壮了；他们过去常常把球猛力踢向我当做消遣。我在学校里总是参加体育运动，尤其是网球和曲棍球，但足球并不在学校的课程表里。”
痴迷运动的菲尔最终选择了足球。在一个女足队伍稀少且相距甚远的时代，凯利在埃塞克斯家门口附近找到了一支球队：“机缘巧合下，有一支名为罗姆福德女足的本土球队。我在16岁时加入了他们，直接进入了成年女子足球领域。一切就是从那里开始的。我为他们效力了几年，直到1990年加入阿森纳。”
当凯利来到罗姆福德时，她几乎没有踢过有组织的11人制足球，但她说自己的特质很容易受到赏识。“我把在街头踢球的经验带到了罗姆福德。我的哥哥们在青年俱乐部和地方球队踢球，我会跟着去踢几脚。我十几岁时打过网球，但我一到罗姆福德，就直接面对二十多岁和三十多岁的成年女性。”
20世纪80年代根本没有针对女孩的少年梯队。“这是直接进入深水区，但那里有很多情谊，年长的球员会照顾你。但我并没有真正接受过战术方法的培训，所以我只是去适应。那里的压力可能更小。我们为了快乐而出现，并且热爱我们所做的事情。”
“我的优势是抢断和头球。我不是特别快，但我对比赛的阅读能力很好，我是一个很好的团队球员。我完成了任务。没有任何花哨的东西。我双脚都能踢球，所以我可以踢左路和右路。”
菲尔在罗姆福德时经常踢中场。“当我来到阿森纳时，维克·阿克斯可能看出我更适合防守。所以我主要踢中后卫或左后卫。我赢下球权，然后直接传给在我前面的人。”
凯利谦虚地承认，为阿森纳效力的机会纯属偶然，尽管当时阿森纳女足成立仅仅三年，尚未确立自己作为女子足球超级豪强的地位：“当我在罗姆福德时，我的教练约翰·格林纳克深度参与了伦敦和埃塞克斯的足球事务，所以我参加了一些跨区域的比赛和锦标赛，那是各郡在选拔球员去参赛。”
“我是伦敦或埃塞克斯阵容的一员，我都记不清了！我遇到了像[前枪手]米歇尔·柯利、柯斯蒂·皮林和维姬·斯利这样的人。我和她们聊天，约翰·格林纳克和维克·阿克斯有着足球方面的联系。维克邀请我去JVC中心和阿森纳一起训练，事情就是从那里开始的。我去了，我没有什么可失去的。”
“阿森纳只存在了几年，但从罗姆福德女足转投阿森纳仍然是一个巨大的飞跃。这是一支正在崛起的俱乐部。我训练了几次，被邀请留下来，剩下的就是历史了。这完全是偶然。”
1990年，阿森纳女足显然处于上升期，但当时还在踢第二级别联赛。到了1993年，她们将赢得国内三冠王。凯利当时有没有预料到阿森纳会变得如此具有统治力？“没有。我想我们谁也没有。我们在1991/92赛季升入顶级联赛，然后球员们开始加盟，比如黛比·班普顿、玛丽亚·拉克赫斯特、玛丽安·斯派西。我们已经有了纳兹·鲍尔和西恩·威廉姆斯这样的球员。安吉·班克斯也跟我们签约了，球队变得越来越强大。”
菲尔解释说，主教练阿克斯建立了一种没有球星架子的文化，建立在努力工作和谦逊的基础之上：“我们都受到平等的对待。我们都到场并做好工作。我们都必须训练，我们都必须出勤，没有人受到特殊待遇。我们的体能和力量就是我们的优势。我们年复一年地一起踢球。但很快我们赢得了三冠王，又一个双冠王——我赢得了极多的冠军！”
“我们都想要同样的东西，没有人是不可战胜的。你必须努力才能保住自己的位置。维克灌输了这种情谊以及我们是谁、我们代表谁的信念。我们虽然不是官方的职业球员，但我们的行为举止就像职业球员一样。”
菲尔说，这种职业素养和位置竞争驱使着球队总是加倍努力。“在20世纪90年代初的某一年，我们在节礼日进行了训练。我们想去那里，因为我们在1月上旬有一场重要的足总杯比赛。其他人是不会这么做的.我们的体能水平为我们赢得了许多比赛。我们并不总是技术最娴熟的球队，但我们的体能和阵容深度是无与伦比的。我们的位置都需要通过竞争来赢得。”
和她那个时代的所有球员一样，菲尔在维持全职工作的同时，还要平衡精英水平的训练、比赛和竞争。
“我是美国运通商务旅行的主管，所以我周一到周五做全职办公室工作。我的雇主知道我在踢足球；他们允许我在午休时工作并在下午4点离开，以便赶去训练或坐大巴去踢客场比赛。我凌晨2点到家，第二天依然会按时上班。”
“我们一周训练几次，但随着我们越来越成功，我们一周训练三次。我围绕着训练来安排我的工作。这在精神上和身体上都很艰难，但你坚持了下来，因为你知道你的队友也在这样做，而且成为那种团队精神的一部分让你坚持了下去。”
毫无疑问，菲尔个人高光时刻出现在1998年的足总杯决赛中。那是一场对阵拥有霍普·鲍威尔等优秀球员的克罗伊登队的跌宕起伏的决赛，在伤停补时阶段比分仍为2-2，当时菲尔前插参与定位球进攻。她攻入了压哨绝杀球赢得了奖杯，凯利解释说，这个时刻比许多人意识到的具有更重大的意义。
“1997年我在法国遭遇了一场严重的车祸，有几个月没有踢球。圣诞节前后，维克找我谈心，鼓励我回到训练场。在杯赛决赛末段攻入制胜球的狂喜已经足够美妙，但这其中还有一些额外的意义。我回到了赛场，我依然能够做到这一点，这意义重大。我们击败了一支伟大的克罗伊登队，但我很高兴自己还能在那里继续踢球。”
“这不是最漂亮的进球——我只在角球和任意球时才会冲上去。我想当时费伊·怀特的射门打中了横梁，而我踢出了我这辈子最硬的一次‘胫骨射门’，但它确实进球了。人们至今还会向我提起那个进球，并不时给我看图片。”自1990年至2003年代表枪手效力，菲尔见证了瑞秋·扬基和凯莉·史密斯等年轻天才的涌现。
“我能看出这两人有着巨大的天赋，而当我走到职业生涯末期时，我看到了所有这些伟大的球员，比如杰恩·勒德洛。世纪之交时，比赛规模越来越大，有了更多的报道和媒体，并且在向前发展。”
“我看着凯莉、瑞秋和杰恩这样的球员，非常感激她们后来取得的成就。仅仅有天赋是不够的。你必须不断产出，否则就不会留下传承——而她们一直在产出。”新一批天才的涌现让凯利开始考虑自己的未来，在那个作为女足运动员并没有真正经济回报的时代。
“2001年我快30岁了。现在的球员职业生涯可以更长久，但她们有体能和身体训练师，而我们当时没有。别误会，我们得到了很多支持——温格来了，大卫·戴恩为我们担保，维克和他们关系很好。我们很幸运，因为我们有理疗师和训练基地，客场比赛前我们住在酒店里。其他球队没有这种待遇。我们得到了很好的照顾。”
“但我有一份全职工作。我们薪水不高，但我们结下了友谊，我们一起旅行，一起赢得了那么多荣誉。但当你到了30岁，晚上去训练时会觉得有点疲惫。像利安妮·桑德森、安妮塔·阿桑特和亚历克斯·斯科特这样的人正在崭露头角，这些年轻球员会取代你的位置。就像我当年进来取代吉尔·怀利一样。”
“我在2001年达到了一个节点，我们刚刚打入欧冠。我们在瑞士踢了比赛，我是阵容的一部分，但我并没有真正上场。我坐在替补席上。我能看出这支球队会变得更大更好、发展得更快，无论我多么想成为其中的一部分，我都想在巅峰时退役。我想按照自己的意愿、以让我满意的水平离开。”
菲尔慢慢开始转型担任阿森纳的教练角色，并在2003年正式退役并开始全职执教。
“我开始协助执教预备队，所以我成了助理教练。英足总开始涌现出女子足校和卓越中心。所以我与克莱尔·惠特利一起参与其中，并考取了教练证书。我并没有完全离开。我做了仅次于踢球的第二好的事情，那就是从U10到U18的教学和传承。”
“我经历了年轻人不断涌现的过渡期。她们中的一些人现在还在俱乐部，如果我能给她们一点点启发，我就可以为此感到骄傲。我过去曾在U10和U12梯队执教过莉娅·威廉姆森，她在比赛时依然能认出我。但在她之前还有像利安妮·桑德森、贝基·斯宾塞和吉利·弗莱厄蒂这样的球员。我在预备队时还执教过亚历克斯·斯科特一小段时间。对我来说，这就像是又一座奖杯。”
菲尔在2008年母亲去世后彻底离开了俱乐部，她说这让她想换一种能花更多时间陪伴父亲的工作方式：“我是自由职业者，因为我有教练证，我和卡姆登议会合作过，我很喜欢那份工作，但工作时间很长，我想照顾我的爸爸。”
“我又回到了商务旅行行业。我依然关注着比赛，并去看比赛。我有很多好朋友至今仍有联系，比如柯斯蒂·皮林、埃玛·伯恩、莱恩·尚普和埃玛·海耶斯。我依然关注比赛，并继续保持着自己的体能锻炼。我作为观众看球；我有年轻的家属在踢球。我的侄子萨姆在切尔西女足担任新闻官。”
菲尔解释说，近年来阿森纳和英格兰女足建立了更坚实的校友倡议，这让她再次走近女子足球。
“2017年，在阿森纳女足成立30周年之际，我又遇到了许多前球员，并参与了阿森纳校友会。这让我重新与安吉·班克斯、西恩·威廉姆斯、米歇尔·柯利、柯斯蒂·皮林和克莱尔·惠特利等人取得了联系。这重新点燃了我对比赛的热情，也让我认识到我所做的事情得到了认可。”
凯利只要有空就会去现场观看阿森纳和英格兰队的比赛：“我在2018年搬到了德文郡，为了过上更安静的生活！我仍然在电视上关注比赛，这一切变得越来越专业了。狮雌军团也与我取得了联系，许多前球员都获得了她们的传承纪念帽。2022年我拿到了我的传承纪念帽，得到认可感觉太棒了。这再次点燃了我内心的某些东西。每当我回到伦敦，我总是会去看比赛：阿森纳和狮雌军团。”
菲尔承认，如今的精英女子足球与她当年作为球员和教练时的环境有着天壤之别。她赢得了五个顶级联赛冠军、五个足总杯冠军和七个联赛杯冠军。那是一个她几乎没有报酬的时代，但凯利没有任何遗憾。“我对赢得的荣誉、赢得的方式、遇到的人以及那些记忆感到非常高兴。为了全世界，我都不会改变这一切。”

items.titleEn: Goalscoring Gabriel reveals pride on his landmark day
items.summaryEn: Get the thoughts from the home changing room in Emirates Stadium following our Premier League game against Everton
bodyEn: After scoring in his 200th Premier League game, Gabriel admitted our 2-0 win over Everton was a hugely proud moment for him.
The centre-back wrapped up the victory by heading in Ben White’s cross midway through the second half, and ensured we would move level at the top of the Premier League table after eight games.

It was his 21st goal for us in the top-flight, and his 14th header - only Olivier Giroud has more for us in the competition’s history. Interestingly, it was also his first from open play, having stayed up with the attack to finish off the move with aplomb.

“I feel really good, it was a nice day for me and to make my 200th Premier League appearance in this shirt is a pleasure,” he said post-match. “I'm really happy, and thank you to the fans for the love, but the most important thing today was the three points.
“I'm always going to be in the box, I want to score, but I also want to be the best in defending the box. Today it happened and I'm really happy to score my first goal of the season.
“I'm really proud of myself. Everything I do is to make myself stronger, to learn every day, and I'm really happy to make my 200th appearance with this shirt.”
Gabi lined up alongside Ezri Konsa in the heart of our defence, and the duo would end up as an unlikely pair of goalscorers to clinch the points.
It was the first time two centre-backs had scored for us in a league match since February 2024, when the Brazilian and William Saliba netted against current Toffees boss David Moyes’ West Ham.
“[Ezri and I] just spoke about it in the dressing room,” Gabi laughed. “We work so hard every day. Today it happened, the two centre-backs scored, so we are really happy.
“He's a top guy; we’ve known his quality since he's arrived at Arsenal. He shows his quality and he can perform at a big level. I'm really happy to have him with us.
“I think we work very hard every day to be the best team, so we are really happy and we keep going. The Premier League has just started and we are ready for the rest of the games.”

items.titleZh: 进球功臣加布里埃尔在里程碑之战后表达自豪
items.summaryZh: 加布里埃尔在英超200场里程碑破门，助阿森纳战胜埃弗顿。
bodyZh: 在迎来个人第200场英超比赛并取得进球后，加布里埃尔坦言，球队2-0战胜埃弗顿对他来说是一个极其自豪的时刻。
这位中后卫在下半场中段接本·怀特的传中头球破门，锁定胜局，并确保我们在进行完8场比赛后积分追平英超榜首。
这是他在英格兰顶级联赛中为我们打入的第21个进球，也是他的第14个头球——在俱乐部该项赛事历史上，只有吉鲁的头球进球数比他更多。有趣这也是他首次在运动战中破门，当时他留在进攻前场，从容地完成了这次终结。
他在赛后表示：“我感觉非常好，这是美好的一天，穿着这件球衣迎来我的第200场英超出场是一种荣幸。我真的很高兴，感谢球迷们的爱，但今天最重要的是全取三分。”
“我总是会出现在禁区里，我想进球，但也想成为防守禁区最出色的球员。今天这一切实现了，我非常高兴能打入本赛季的个人首球。”
“我为自己感到非常自豪。我所做的一切都是为了让自己变得更强大、每天都在学习，穿着这件球衣完成200场比赛让我感到非常高兴。”
加比与埃兹里·孔萨一同搭档镇守防线，这两位中卫最终出人意料地双双破门，为球队锁定胜局。
这是自2024年2月以来，首次有两名中卫在联赛单场比赛中为我们进球。当时正是这位巴西人和威廉·萨利巴在对阵目前执教太妃糖的主帅大卫·莫耶斯的西汉姆联时双双破门。
加比笑着说：“我和埃兹里刚在更衣室里聊过这件事。我们每天都努力训练。今天发生这样的事了，两个中后卫都进了球，所以我们真的很高兴。”
“他是个顶尖的人；自从他加盟阿森纳以来，我们就有目共睹他的实力。他展现了自己的水平，并且能够在重大比赛中发挥作用。我很高兴能有他陪伴在我们身边。”
“我认为我们每天都在努力训练，力求成为最出色的球队，所以我们非常高兴，并且会继续前进。英超联赛才刚刚开始，我们已经为接下来的比赛做好了准备。”

items.titleEn: Every word from Arteta's post-Everton press conference
items.summaryEn: Discover what the boss had to say following our win over the Toffees
bodyEn: We moved level on points with the top of the Premier League on Saturday, following a 2-0 win over Everton at Emirates Stadium.
Ezri Konsa netted his first for the club to open the scoring in the first half, before Gabriel marked his 200th Premier League appearance with the second goal to help seal victory.
Mikel Arteta addressed the media after the win in N5, and this is what he had to say...

on closing the gap at the top:We’re very happy with the victory, the performance and the week, because we were given a terrible schedule. Playing Sunday afternoon, then Wednesday night in Munich, coming here really late on Thursday and then having to play again in the Premier League against a really tough opponent on Saturday at 3pm. We have overcome some injuries, and I’m really proud of the mentality of the team in the conditions today.

on Gabriel seemingly getting injured and then scoring:He’s a clear example when I’m talking about the mentality of the team, meaning as well the mentality of individuals. Immediately after he went down, he said he wanted to continue, and then he scored the goal that helped us win the game. That’s what we need from our players.
on Riccardo Calafiori’s fitness:He had a light issue, we’re not quite sure what it is, something very small, but he was cautious of that.

on Noni Madueke’s performance:I’m very impressed, and to have that availability with him is really necessary because of the injuries to Bukayo and Christos, two players who give us so much threat in the final third. I like him, and if he continues to transform his capacity to be more consistent in actions, he’s an unbelievable player.

on our midfielders rotating throughout the game:It depends on the opponent. It’s a team that if you give them clear reference, it’s extremely difficult to break them down. That’s why we had the profile we had in midfield to start with; they decided to become a bit more active, and we understood it really well to occupy the spaces and hurt them in the right moments. It’s the dynamic and understanding that we need from our players, and it will get better and better throughout the season.

on Ezri Konsa acclimatising himself so quickly:Unbelievable. To come to a club like Arsenal with no pre-season, Saliba is here and other players, and to position yourself in that manner with the naturality he has and put in the performances he has - the chemistry with Gabi that is so solid - is so difficult to do. We’re lucky to have him.

on our goals:The two centre-backs scored the goals today. We hadn’t scored from a set-piece, which we were disappointed with because we generate so many chances. I believe we should have scored at least two from set pieces against Bayern Munich, and that would’ve won us the game. We want to be the best in every phase of play, and we won’t stop until we do it.

on if he’s surprised it took us so long to score a set-piece goal:I was sure it was going to unlock something, and the belief of the players. They are already convinced, the level of attention when we train and what they believe in what Nico [Jover] does, there is no question of that. But in the end, it has to come through and make the difference - and that is a massive one for us.

on receiving his second yellow card of the season:I do have to be careful, put sensors there [on the edge of the technical area]! There are managers that have the record in the league, 36 times in 10 minutes they leave the touchline, no yellows. I’m clipping all of that, I have a massive storage of images, I don't have the record yet. Let’s see - then it’s 36 yellow cards in 10 minutes for managers, where are we going to be then? Let’s see.
on keeping momentum going at the top:We just have to focus on what we can do, and we’re very pleased with 90% of the performances and results - apart from the Brighton game, I would say.

on our strong defensive structure with Saliba still out:William is not fit, and we’re desperate to have him back because we know what Wilo does for us. Mosquera when he plays will be the same, because between them in the way they train to improve, and how they look after each other, it’s the beauty of our team.

on if scoring early helped dictate the tempo today:I think today my fear was the longer they stay in the result, score first, and it drives into 65, 70 minutes, then we have a problem. So I wanted us to be very aggressive from the beginning, go for it and try to impose ourselves early in the match.

on winning despite making five changes:That’s great for us, and will for sure make me do it again. We have no reason not to do it, because we have an unbelievable group of players with the right mentality who are all ready to play their part when they’re ready. They did that today.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赛后新闻发布会言论汇总
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔谈战胜埃弗顿、球队心态及球员表现。
bodyZh: 周六在酋长球场以2-0击败埃弗顿后，我们在积分榜上追平了英超榜首。
Ezri Konsa在上半场打入加盟球队以来的首球打破僵局，随后加布里埃尔迎来了他的第200场英超里程碑并打入第二球，帮助球队锁定胜局。
阿尔特塔在N5地区的胜利后接受了媒体采访，以下是他的讲话内容……
关于缩小榜首差距：我们对这场胜利、表现和这周的成果感到非常高兴，因为我们经历了一赛程极其艰难的魔鬼赛程。周日下午比赛，然后周三晚上去慕尼黑踢客场，周四很晚才赶回来，接着周六下午3点又必须在英超迎战一个非常强硬的对手。我们克服了一些伤病，我为球队在今天条件下的精神面貌感到无比骄傲。
关于加布里埃尔疑似受伤随后又进球：当我谈论球队的心态时，他就是一个鲜明的例子，这也意味着个人的心态。他倒地后立即表示想要坚持，随后他就打入了帮助我们赢得比赛的进球。这就是我们需要球员展现的素质。
关于里卡多·卡拉菲奥里的身体状况：他有一点轻微的问题，我们不太确定具体是什么，是非常小的一个情况，但他对此保持了谨慎。
关于诺尼·马杜埃克的表现：我印象非常深刻，由于萨卡和赫里斯托斯的受伤——这两位在进攻三区给我们带来巨大威胁的球员——我们需要他的出场保障。我很喜欢他，如果他能继续提升自己动作的稳定性，他将是一名不可思议的球员。
关于我们的中场球员在全场比赛中的轮换：这取决于对手。如果你给他们清晰的参照，这支球队会变得极其难以击破。这就是为什么我们在中场一开始就派出了这种人员配置；他们决定变得更积极一些，而我们很好地理解了如何占据空间并在正确的时机打击他们。这是我们需要球员具备的动态和理解力，随着赛季的进行，这会越来越好。
关于Ezri Konsa如何如此迅速地适应：难以置信。来到像阿森纳这样没有季前备战的俱乐部，萨利巴等其他球员都在这里，他能以那种自然的姿态将自己定位在那个位置并交出这样的表现——与加布里埃尔之间如此稳固的化学反应——这太难做到了。我们很幸运能拥有他。
关于我们的进球：今天两个中卫取得了进球。我们之前没有通过定位球得分，对此我们感到失望，因为我们创造了那么多机会。我认为我们在对阵拜仁慕尼黑的比赛中本应该通过定位球至少进两个球，那本可以赢得比赛。我们希望在比赛的每个阶段都做到最好，在我们达成目标之前绝不会停下脚步。
关于是否惊讶我们花了这么长时间才打入定位球：我确信这会解开某些东西，球员们的信念也是如此。他们已经深信不疑，我们在训练中的专注度以及他们对尼科[若维尔]工作的信任，这是毫无疑问的。但最终，它必须兑现并发挥出决定性作用——对我们来说这是一个巨大的改变。
关于吃到本赛季第二张黄牌：我确实得小心点，在技术区边缘装上感应器！有些教练在联赛里有纪录，10分钟内36次离开技术区都没有黄牌。我把这些全剪辑下来了，我有一大堆图像资料，我还没破纪录呢。让我们看看——然后教练们在10分钟内吃36张黄牌，我们到时候会变成什么样？让我们拭目以待。
关于保持在榜首的势头：我们只需要专注于我们能做的事，对于90%的表现和结果我们都非常满意——除了对阵布莱顿的那场比赛，我想是的。
关于在萨利巴仍然缺阵的情况下保持稳固的防守结构：威廉现在身体状况不佳，我们迫切希望他能回归，因为我们知道威廉对我们的意义。莫斯克拉上场时也会是一样的，因为他们俩在训练中的互相提升以及如何照顾彼此，这就是我们团队的美妙之处。
关于早早进球是否有助于掌控今天的节奏：我认为今天的担忧是如果他们长时间保持这个比分，先进球，比赛拖到第65、70分钟，那我们就会遇到麻烦。所以我希望我们从一开始就极具侵略性，全力以赴，并在比赛刚开始时就试图掌控场面。
关于在做出五处轮换的情况下取胜：这对我们来说太棒了，这绝对会让我再次这么做。我们没有理由不这么做，因为我们拥有一群心态正确、不可思议的球员，他们随时准备好在需要时发挥自己的作用。他们今天做到了。

items.titleEn: Arteta praises our mentality and defensive trio's efforts
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta speaks about our 2-0 Premier League victory against Everton at Emirates Stadium
bodyEn: After his side picked up two Premier League wins either side of a draw at Bayern Munich over the past week, Mikel Arteta lauded his players for constantly overcoming adversity to keep our impressive start to the season going.

We moved level on points at the top of the table after beating Everton 2-0, following on from Sunday’s win at Nottingham Forest. Those games were sandwiched between an impressive draw in Germany, and despite that test against one of the world’s best teams and the travel involved, Mikel was delighted we still found a way to beat the Toffees.

With 11 wins from 13 games this season, Mikel heaped praise on his players for their mentality and their ability to find the energy and desire to go again, regardless of the fixture list's challenges.

“I’m very happy,” he summed up after our latest victory. “It was a really difficult game, considering where we’re coming from: Forest on Sunday, Wednesday night in Munich, coming back very late on Thursday, and having to play a very tough opponent like Everton.

“But I’m very pleased with the performance of the team, how dominant we were throughout the game in very difficult conditions as well. We made changes, and still I think we fully deserved to win the game.
“We lost some players as well - but the team seems to adapt, be more willing to offer something else to overcome the challenge and win the game. Today, I loved the mindset of the team.”

Our defenders' attacking talent secured the win. Ezri Konsa scored his first Gunners goal which was added to by his central defensive partner Gabriel, who brushed off a potential injury to return to the field and grab a goal on his 200th Premier League appearance.

That was assisted by Ben White, who was playing his 200th game for the club in all competitions, and was the third time he’d laid on a goal for a teammate already in 2026/27. Mikel was keen to praise the trio for their efforts at both ends of the pitch.

When asked about what’s impressed him most about Ezri’s start to life in N5, he said: “His personality, his aura, I think he has something about him which makes him click immediately with the club, the team, the staff, and the performances he’s putting in.

“He’s been outstanding in every single match with his capacity to lead, the composure he has in difficult actions especially that he has to face in the manner that we play, and then he’s created that relationship with Gabi that seems to be very strong.

“Gabi was unbelievable. I think the action that leads to the possible injury, and then the way he overcomes that situation with his willingness to go again and to score that goal. It’s a great description of what he is as a player and as a leader in this club.
“Ben is in a really good moment, he’s matured a lot from the Ben that we knew from a few years ago to Ben now. It’s just an immense transformation at every level, and we’re lucky to have him.”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔称赞球队心态与防线三人的努力
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔谈阿森纳在酋长球场2-0战胜埃弗顿。
bodyZh: 在过去一周经历客场战平拜仁慕尼黑以及两场英超胜利后，阿尔特塔称赞球员们不断克服逆境，延续了本赛季的出色开局。
在以2-0击败埃弗顿（延续了周日客胜诺丁汉森林的良好势头）后，我们的积分追平了积分榜榜首。这些比赛中间穿插着一场在德国的出色平局，尽管面对世界最佳球队之一且伴随舟车劳顿，米克尔依然很高兴我们找到了击败太妃糖的方法。
本赛季13场比赛赢下11场，米克尔对球员的心态以及无论赛程如何挑战都能重新焕发体能与渴望的能力大加赞赏。
我们在取得最新一场胜利后，他总结道：“我非常高兴。考虑到我们的近况：周日光温特、周三晚上在慕尼黑、周四很晚才回来，还要迎战埃弗顿这样一个非常难缠的对手，这真是一场艰难的比赛。”
“但我对球队的表现非常满意，在非常艰难的条件下，我们在整场比赛中占据了主导地位。我们进行了换人调整，但我认为我们依然完全配得上这场胜利。”
“我们也失去了一些球员，但球队似乎能够适应，更愿意付出更多来克服挑战并赢得比赛。今天，我非常喜欢球队的心态。”
我们后卫的进攻才华确保了胜利。孔萨打入了他在枪手的处子球，随后其中卫搭档加布里埃尔在克服潜在伤情后重返球场，并在他个人的第200场英超联赛中斩获进球。
这一进球由本·怀特助攻，这是他代表俱乐部的各项赛事第200场比赛，也是他在2026/27赛季第三次为队友送出助攻。米克尔对这三人在攻防两端的努力给予了高度评价。
当被问及最对孔萨在北伦敦开始的职业生涯印象深刻的是什么时，他说：“他的个性、他的气场，我认为他有一种魔力，能让他立刻与俱乐部、球队、教练组以及他所奉献的表现契合。”
“他在每一场比赛中都表现出色，具备领导能力，在面对我们这种踢法所带来的艰难局面时表现得非常沉着，而且他与加布里埃尔建立起了看起来非常牢固的关系。”
“加布里埃尔太不可思议了。我认为导致可能受伤的那次动作，以及他克服那种情况、重新投入比赛并打入那个进球的方式，完美诠释了他作为这支俱乐部的球员和领袖的特质。”
“本目前状态正佳，与几年前我们认识的那个本相比，他成熟了很多。这是一种全方位的巨大蜕变，我们很幸运能拥有他。”

bodyEn: The wait goes on for David Moyes. The 63-year-old Scot must have been hoping that on his 14th visit to this stadium as Everton’s manager, his luck would change. Yet from the moment Ezri Konsa slammed home his first goal for Arsenal as the Premier League champions rediscovered their knack of scoring from set pieces, the writing was on the wall.

While it took until midway through the second half for Gabriel Magalhães to make sure of the victory, Arsenal were never going to let slip the chance of moving level on points at the top with Manchester City after their defeat by Aston Villa earlier in the day.

Asked whether it was strange that his side are again going toe-to-toe with their great rivals but with the added uncertainty of what punishment City will receive after being found guilty of 115 charges by the Premier League, Mikel Arteta said: “[We are] just focusing on what we can do. We are very pleased with 90% of the results and performances that we have.”

This was hardly a vintage performance from the clinical home side after a testing week but it did not need to be against opponents who offered precious little in attack, even if they defended for their lives at times.
Having gone six matches without defeat to start the season, a second in succession will only add to Everton’s concerns after confirmation that the club’s American owners want out.

“It was always going to be hard after conceding the early goal,” said Moyes, whose solitary victory at the Emirates was as West Ham’s manager in 2023. “I want us to challenge the top teams but it’s difficult when you see the strength of their bench.”

Everton’s record at this stadium is almost as bad as their manager’s. They arrived in north London having won twice in 35 matches here and had to do without Jarrad Branthwaite and Jack Grealish, who was ruled out with illness. It did not bode well for them when Arsenal took the lead in the seventh minute with a third corner in succession.

Gabriel made the crucial first contact at the near post and Jordan Pickford tipped the ball on to the crossbar, only for Vitaliy Mykolenko’s failed clearance under pressure from Viktor Gyökeres to allow Konsa to ram home from close range. After a record-breaking 25 goals from set pieces last season, it was their first of this campaign.
It was a measure of Arsenal’s exertions against Bayern Munich on Wednesday that Arteta rotated his side more than usual for a Premier League match, making five changes.

Eberechi Eze and Noni Madueke spurned good opportunities to extend the lead in front of the watching England head coach, Thomas Tuchel. The latter was left out of the last squad, but could well benefit from Bukayo Saka’s expected long absence due to a thigh injury. He was inches away with an instinctive effort with his right foot from the edge of the area on the half-hour mark and was consistently Arsenal’s most dangerous threat.
Everton must have feared the worst as yet another Arsenal corner – 10 during the first half – was launched into the area. Yet the defence just about stood firm.

A moment’s lapse of concentration from Ben White just before half-time almost gave Everton an equaliser but Thierno Barry could not get enough on his attempt to flick the ball past David Raya in their clearest opening.
Gyökeres looked determined to make an impression on his first Premier League start of the season but the Sweden striker, who has yet to score for his club this term, looked laboured.

• With both Arsenal and Manchester City doing so this season, this is just the third top-flight campaign to have two teams win at least seven of their opening eight matches after 1892-93 (Preston and Sunderland) and 1913-14 (Blackburn and Manchester United).
• This was David Moyes’s 400th defeat across all competitions in his managerial career with all clubs. 31 of these have come against Arsenal, more than against any other opponent.
• The opener from Ezri Konsa (pictured celebrating) was Arsenal’s first set piece goal (excluding penalties) since May against Crystal Palace, ending a run of 13 games without one. Opta

He could not believe it when Tony Harrington penalised him for a foul on James Tarkowski and a sheepish Arteta earned himself a booking for protesting. Unsurprisingly, Gyökeres’ number was up soon after as Arsenal turned to their bench.
It took less than 60 seconds for Gabriel to head in at the back post as White offered Tuchel a timely reminder of his qualities with a brilliant cross.
Moyes’ frustration meant he joined Arteta in the referee’s notebook. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall could have made things interesting but his header fizzed just wide of a post.
Arsenal are now breathing down City’s necks, although whether this title race lasts the course remains unknown.

items.titleZh: 孔萨与加布里埃尔建功，阿森纳击败埃弗顿
items.summaryZh: 孔萨与加布里埃尔进球，阿森纳在主场击败埃弗顿。
bodyZh: 大卫·莫耶斯的等待还在继续。这位63岁的苏格兰人一定曾希望，在他作为埃弗顿主帅第14次做客这座球场时，自己的运气能有所改变。然而，当埃兹里·孔萨斩获他加盟阿森纳后的首粒进球，帮助这位英超卫冕冠军重新展现定位球得分能力的那一刻起，比赛的结局便已注定。
尽管直到下半场中段加布里埃尔·马加良斯才锁定胜局，但在曼城此前输给阿斯顿维拉之后，阿森纳绝不会错过这场积分追平领头羊的绝佳机会。
当被问及与老对手再次展开争夺是否有些奇怪，且曼城因被英超指控115项违规后面临何种处罚仍存不确定性时，米克尔·阿尔特塔表示：“我们只专注于我们能做的事情。对于90%的比赛结果和表现，我们都非常满意。”
经历了考验重重的一周后，表现高效的主队此役并非踢出了一场经典之战，但面对在进攻端几乎毫无建树、有时甚至拼死防守的对手，他们也无需踢得多么华丽。
在经历开局六场不败后，埃弗顿遭遇了连败，而在俱乐部美国老板寻求出售的确认传出后，这无疑会加剧球队的担忧。
“在过早丢球之后，比赛总是会变得异常艰难，”莫耶斯说道，他在酋长球场的唯一一场胜利还是2023年率领西汉姆联时取得的。“我希望我们能向顶级球队发起挑战，但看看他们替补席的厚度，这真的很困难。”
埃弗顿在这座球场的战绩几乎和他们主帅的客场战绩一样糟糕。他们来到北伦敦时带着在这里35场仅赢2场的纪录，并且缺少了扎拉德·布兰思韦特以及因病缺阵的杰克·格拉利什。当阿森纳在第7分钟利用连续第三个角球率先破门时，这对他们来说绝对不是什么好兆头。
加布里埃尔在近门柱抢到关键第一落点，皮克福德将球扑到横梁上，随后维塔利·米科连科在维克托·哲凯赖什的逼抢下解围失误，孔萨近距离推射破门。上赛季他们创纪录地打入25个定位球，这是他们本赛季的第一个定位球进球。
为了应对周三与拜仁慕尼黑的恶战，阿尔特塔本场在英超联赛中做出了比以往更多的轮换，首发阵容调整了五处。
在现场观战的英格兰主帅托马斯·图赫尔面前，埃贝雷奇·埃泽和农尼·马杜埃凯错失了扩大比分的良机。后者落选了上一期大名单，但很可能因布卡约·萨卡因大腿受伤预计将长期缺阵而受益。在上半场进行到第30分钟时，他用右脚在禁区边缘完成了一脚极具本能的射门，距离进球仅毫厘之差，并且自始至终都是阿森纳最具威胁的球员。
面对阿森纳在上半场罚出的第10个角球，埃弗顿一定感到凶多吉少。不过，他们的防线最终还是勉强守住了。
本·怀特在上半场结束前的一次注意力不集中几乎让埃弗顿扳平比分，但蒂尔诺·巴里在面对大卫·拉亚时没能充分完成推射，错失了他们全场最清晰的破门良机。
哲凯赖什似乎决心在本赛季他的首次英超首发出场中证明自己，但这位尚未在本赛季为俱乐部进球的瑞典前锋显得有些吃力。
随着阿森纳和曼城在本赛季均做到这一点，这是自1892-93赛季（普雷斯顿和桑德兰）以及1913-14赛季（布莱克本和曼联）以来，顶级联赛历史上第三次出现两支球队在开局前八场比赛中至少赢得七场的情况。
这是大卫·莫耶斯执教生涯各项赛事遭遇的第400场失利。其中有31场是对阵阿森纳，超过了他面对任何其他对手时的失利场次。
埃兹里·孔萨的闪击破门是阿森纳自5月对阵水晶宫以来打入的首个非点球定位球，从而结束了此前13场比赛定位球颗粒无收的尴尬纪录（数据来源：Opta）。
当主裁判托尼·哈灵顿判罚他对詹姆斯·塔科夫斯基犯规时，他简直不敢相信，而略显羞涩的阿尔特塔也因为抗议吃到了一张黄牌。不出所料，阿森纳随后便用替补球员换下了哲凯赖什。
仅仅用了不到60秒，加布里埃尔就在后点接怀特的精妙传中头球破门，怀特也借此再次及时向图赫尔展现了自己的能力。
莫耶斯的沮丧情绪让他在裁判的笔记本上也添上了名字。基兰·杜斯伯里-霍尔本有机会让比赛重现悬念，但他的头球擦着门柱偏出。
阿森纳目前正紧追曼城不放，尽管这场争冠大戏能否持续到最后目前仍未可知。

items.summaryEn: Goals from Ezri Konsa and Gabriel saw us beat Everton and move level on points at the top of the Premier League table
bodyEn: Goals from our central defensive duo Ezri Konsa and Gabriel saw us beat Everton and move level on points with Manchester City at the top of the Premier League table.

We grabbed the lead just seven minutes in at a rain-soaked Emirates Stadium when Konsa netted his first Gunners goal after a corner, and while we carved out numerous good opportunities, we had to wait until midway through the second half for the all-important second when Gabriel headed in on his 200th Premier League appearance.
After City’s defeat at Aston Villa earlier in the day, our record of seven wins from our first eight league games matches the Citizens’, with only goal difference keeping us off the summit.
KONSA’S QUICK START

Before kick-off, there was a moving tribute to Ken Friar, who passed away last week aged 92. Both sets of players joined the rest of the crowd in a minute's applause as a tribute video played, rightly honouring a club stalwart.
The spirit of the occasion carried us through the first few moments as we laid siege to the visiting goal, forcing a series of corners that ultimately led to us taking the lead in the seventh minute.

Martin Odegaard’s front-post delivery was flicked goalwards by Gabriel, forcing Jordan Pickford to throw himself across his line to flick it up onto the bar. He saw the ball land between a thicket of players, but Konsa reacted quickest to prod it home and register his first Gunners goal.
CHANCES GALORE

Both teams entered this game having been beaten just once this term, and Everton fought back to protect their unbeaten away record. A low James Garner attempt forced David Raya into his first work, and then after Tyrqiue George’s curler was flicked wide by Ben White’s toe, the resulting corner required Gabriel to hack off his goalline after Raya miscued a punch.

As the game approached the half-hour mark, Noni Madueke then came to the fore, twice producing brilliant skill to carve out opportunities. Firstly he spun away from a defender to get into the box but dragged his effort wide, and then nearly netted a goal of the season contender when he superbly plucked the ball out of the air while spinning, and his first-time shot caught Pickford out, but rippled the near post’s side netting.

Odegaard then dribbled through five Everton defenders and only a sliding block by Vitalii Mykolenko stopped him from netting his own golden goal, but despite plenty of fine attacking play and being firmly in control, the fragility of our lead was highlighted just before the interval when White’s poor header back allowed Thierno Barry a sniff, but Raya anticipated the danger.
BIG GABI’S BIG GOAL

Neither side tested either goalkeeper in the opening 15 minutes, and the period’s biggest moment came when Gabriel needed treatment after landing awkwardly while cutting out a pass. But thankfully, the Brazilian was OK to continue, as he made the difference on 68 minutes by grabbing our second.

Having just been introduced as part of a triple substitution, Bruno Guimaraes fed White down the right, and the right-back - making his 200th Arsenal appearance - beat the offside trap and clipped the ball towards the back post, where Gabriel was waiting to mark his own landmark game by heading past Pickford.

That would extend Everton’s miserable record in our corner of north London to one win from 31 visits, although had Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall’s flicked header crept a yard closer to the goal with eight minutes to go, we could have been in a grandstand finish.

But we registered an eighth straight win on our own patch, sending our supporters happy before three away games in a row, including a trip to the red half of Merseyside next Sunday for a big clash against Everton’s arch-rivals Liverpool.
FACTS AND STATS

With both Manchester City and us doing so this season, this is just the third top-flight campaign to have two teams win at least seven of their opening eight matches after 1892/93 (Preston and Sunderland) and 1913/14 (Blackburn and Manchester United).
This was David Moyes’ 400th defeat in all competitions across his managerial career. 31 of these have come against us, more than against any other opponent.
Gabriel’s goal was his 14th headed goal in the Premier League, with only Olivier Giroud (27) scoring more headers for us in the competition (Ian Wright also 14).
Ezri Konsa’s opener was our first set-piece goal (excluding penalties) since May against Crystal Palace, ending a run of 13 games without one.
Konsa became the 10th player whose first Premier League goal for us came against Everton. Only against Aston Villa (11) have more players scored their first goal for the club in the competition.
In his 200th Premier League appearance, Gabriel scored his 21st goal in the competition, and his first not to come from a set-piece situation.
In Gabriel and Ezri Konsa, we had two centre-backs score in a Premier League match for the first time since February 2024 (Gabriel and William Saliba against David Moyes’ West Ham).
WHAT'S NEXT

We head to fourth-tier Fleetwood Town in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday night, before another trip to the north-west to face Liverpool the following Sunday. Then we're on our travels again with a Champions League encounter with Slavia Prague on Wednesday, November 4.

items.titleZh: 战报：阿森纳 2-0 埃弗顿
items.summaryZh: 孔萨和加布里埃尔破门，阿森纳2-0击败埃弗顿，积分追平英超榜首。
bodyZh: 中后卫组合埃兹里·孔萨和加布里埃尔的进球帮助我们击败了埃弗顿，在英超积分榜上积分追平了曼城。
在雨中的酋长球场，开场仅仅七分钟我们就取得了领先，孔萨在角球进攻中打入了他在阿森纳的处子球。尽管我们创造了许多良机，但直到下半场中段，我们才等来了至关重要的第二球，加布里埃尔迎来了他的第200场英超联赛并头球破门。
在曼城早些时候输给阿斯顿维拉之后，我们在前八场联赛中取得了七场胜利，战绩与曼城持平，仅因净胜球劣势位居次席。
孔萨闪击建立优势
开球前，全场对上周以92岁高龄去世的肯·弗里亚尔进行了感人的悼念。现场播放了致敬视频，双方球员与全场球迷一同鼓掌一分钟，向这位功勋卓越的俱乐部老臣致以敬意。
比赛开局的良好氛围鼓舞了我们，我们对客队球门发起猛攻，制造了一系列角球，最终在第七分钟转化为进球。
厄德高主罚前点，加布里埃尔头球攻门，迫使皮克福德飞身扑救将球蹭到横梁上。皮球落在一堆球员中间，孔萨反应最快将球捅进网窝，收获了他在阿森纳的第一个进球。
错失良机与对手反扑
双方在本场比赛前都只输过一场，埃弗顿随后奋起反击以捍卫他们客场不败的纪录。詹姆斯·加纳的低射迫使大卫·拉亚做出本场首次扑救，随后泰里奇·乔治的弧线球被本·怀特轻蹭出底线，随后的角球由于拉亚击球失误，逼得加布里埃尔在门线上解围。
比赛接近半小时大关时，农尼·马杜埃凯表现活跃，两次展现出色的个人技术创造机会。首先他转身摆脱后卫突入禁区却将射门打偏，差一点攻入赛季最佳进球——他在空中完美停球并转身，第一时间起脚劲射骗过了皮克福德，可惜击中了近门柱的外侧网窝。
随后厄德高盘带穿过了五名埃弗顿球员，只有米克连科的滑铲封堵才阻止他打进精彩进球。尽管进攻极为流畅且牢牢掌控局势，但在中场休息前，本·怀特一次糟糕的回顶险些让蒂尔诺·巴里获得机会，好在拉亚及时化解了险情。
大加布的头球建功
双方门将在前15分钟都没有受到太多考验，这段时间最大的插曲是加布里埃尔在拦截传球时落地不稳接受治疗。幸运的是，这位巴西国脚能够继续坚持比赛，并在第68分钟通过进球扩大了领先优势。
作为三换一调整的一部分替补登场的布鲁诺·吉马雷斯将球传给右路的本·怀特，迎来了自己第200场阿森纳出场的这位右后卫反越位成功，将球传向后门柱，加布里埃尔候个正着，头球攻破皮克福德的大门，以此纪念自己的里程碑之战。
这也延续了埃弗顿在北伦敦惨淡的交锋纪录，31次做客仅取得1场胜利。不过如果凯尔安·迪斯伯里-霍尔在比赛还剩八分钟时的头球攻门再靠近一码，我们可能会迎来一个惊心动魄的收官阶段。
但我们最终在主场取得了八连胜，在开启连续三个客场之旅（包括下周日前往默西塞德郡红半天挑战宿敌利物浦）之前，让球迷们满意而归。
比赛数据与事实
随着曼城和我们在本赛季都做到这一点，这是顶级联赛历史上第三次出现两支球队在前八场比赛中至少赢下七场的赛季，前两次分别是在1892/93赛季（普雷斯顿和桑德兰）以及1913/14赛季（布莱克本和曼联）。
这是大卫·莫耶斯执教生涯各项赛事中的第400场失利。其中31场是对阵我们，超过了他面对任何其他对手的失利次数。
加布里埃尔的这个进球是他在英超联赛中的第14个头球破门，在队史该项数据上只有吉鲁（27个）的头球进球更多（伊恩·赖特也是14个）。
埃兹里·孔萨的进球是我们自5月对阵水晶宫以来打进的第一粒定位球（点球除外），打破了连续13场没有定位球破门的荒。
孔萨成为了第10位在英超对阵埃弗顿打进自己阿森纳联赛处子球的球员。只有对阵阿斯顿维拉（11人）时，才有更多球员在英超为俱乐部打进处子球。
在其第200场英超联赛中，加布里埃尔攻入了他在该联赛的第21个进球，这也是他首次在非定位球情况下进球。
凭借加布里埃尔和埃兹里·孔萨的破门，我们迎来了自2024年2月（加布里埃尔和萨利巴对阵大卫·莫耶斯的西汉姆联）以来，首次在英超单场比赛中有两名中后卫同时进球。
赛程预告
周二晚，我们将前往英乙球队弗利特伍德参加联赛杯，随后于下周日再次前往西北部对阵利物浦。接着我们在11月4日星期三还将迎来客场对阵布拉格斯拉维亚的欧冠比赛。

items.titleEn: Caitlin buzzing after north London derby win
items.summaryEn: Winning the derby means more to Caitlin Foord than any other fixture, so she was over the moon following Saturday’s success
bodyEn: Winning the north London derby means more to Caitlin Foord than any other fixture, so she was over the moon following Saturday’s success at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
Making her first start of the season for us in the Women’s Super League, she helped us to come from behind and protect a one-goal margin for a huge win that felt like it had been a long time coming.

Speaking to us after the game, she said: “It's the one game I always look to personally. So yes, I was excited to obviously get the start today. First one of the season, so yes, I was just excited to get out there and obviously do what I can do for the team.

“I knew everyone was going to go out there and give it everything and leave everything out there. I think that showed at the end, just getting in the tackles, winning balls, clearing and going wide. We had each other's back out there and yes, it felt good.”
One interesting element of the line-up was the decision to play Olivia Smith up top with Alessia Russo in behind, so how did Foord find linking up with those two in those roles?
“It was good,” she said. “I felt like it felt good. Obviously, I have a good connection with Less as it is and then yes, having Liv's speed for the support in behind as well was really nice.”
Of course, we couldn’t let Foord go without asking what it felt like to have such fantastic support from almost 4,000 Arseanl fans on the day.

“They were huge, obviously, to sell out the away section and to have so many of them show up, especially when we obviously haven't had the results we wanted to,” she said. “So yes, it was so nice and we just wanted to be able to do it for them today.
“We’ve had their support throughout it all and it's again today. So yes, I think out of everything, we wanted to be able to do it for them today.”

items.titleZh: 凯特琳对赢得北伦敦德比感到兴奋
items.summaryZh: 对凯特琳·福德而言，赢得德比意义重大，她在周六取胜后欣喜若狂。
bodyZh: 对凯特琳·福德（Caitlin Foord）来说，赢得北伦敦德比的意义超过任何其他比赛，因此在周六于托特纳姆热刺球场取得胜利后，她感到欣喜若狂。
这是她本赛季首次在女足超级联赛中为阿森纳先发登场，她帮助球队在落后情况下逆转，并守住了一球优势，这场意义重大的胜利让人感觉等了很久。
她在赛后接受采访时表示：“这是我个人最期待的一场比赛。所以是的，我很高兴今天能首发。这是本赛季第一次，所以是的，我很高兴能上场，并为球队尽我所能。”
“我知道每个人都会全力以赴，把一切留在球场上。我认为最后这一点得到了体现，无论是拼抢、赢得球权、解围还是拉开宽度。我们在场上互为后盾，感觉真好。”
首发阵容中一个有趣的安排是让奥利维亚·史密斯（Olivia Smith）担任箭头人物，阿莱西亚·鲁索（Alessia Russo）在其身后，那么福德如何看待与这两人在这些位置上的配合呢？
她说道：“感觉很好。我感觉配合得很默契。显然我和莱斯（Less）本来就很有默契，而且拥有利夫（Liv）的速度在身后支持，这也非常棒。”
当然，我们不能不问问福德，在比赛当天得到近4000名阿森纳球迷如此出色的支持是什么感觉。
她表示：“他们太棒了，客场看台座无虚席，有这么多人现身支持，尤其是在我们没有取得想要的结果的时候。所以是的，这太美好了，我们今天只想为他们赢下比赛。”
“一路走来，我们一直得到他们的支持，今天也是如此。所以是的，我觉得在所有事情中，我们今天最想做的就是为他们赢下这场比赛。”

items.summaryEn: Renée Slegers reflects on our north London derby win, as we came from behind to beat Tottenham Hotspur
bodyEn: ​​​​Renée Slegers was all smiles in the tunnel following Saturday’s 2-1 win away to Tottenham Hotspur.
The head coach saw us come from behind to claim all three points and the bragging rights thanks to goals from Georgia Stanway and Alessia Russo.
Reflecting on the match, she said: “Three points in the north London derby, playing for the fans today. I'm so happy for everyone, but for the fans, that's why we were celebrating with them as well.

“To get the three points today, it was difficult, it was a fight. It asked a lot from us, also coming back from a goal down. But the way we do it, with the intensity, the fight and character in the team, I'm so pleased.”

Commenting on Stanway’s goal, after our midfielder linked up well with Olivia Smith and Russo, Renée continued: “Good, very good. It was amazing. I think that's what we've been talking about as well. See the opening in the box, make the right decision to see who's in the best position to finish for us. And they did that so well. I think it's Less pulling it back for Georgia. Great goal.”
Once Russo fired us in front from the penalty spot early in the second half, the head coach was delighted with how we protected the lead, not allowing Spurs to have any big chances to equalise.

“Because you know it's only one goal difference, Tottenham is still in the game, there were some fighting warrior performances out there today from the whole team,” she said. “There's a couple that just injected into the team. I thought Caitlin Foord was amazing. Georgia in the middle of the pitch, the back line. And then the decisions we make at the end. We slowed the game down when we needed to, go to the corners, continue to win our duels. Really happy.”

At the end of the game some of our players instinctively expressed their excitement, running over to almost 4,000 Arsenal supporters to celebrate before returning to the middle of the pitch to shake the hands of their opponents.

On that fantastic support, Renée said: “It's been difficult times for them as well. But they show up here with all of them and we're selling out the away section. And they're there for us and they're seeing us through the game. So we said there's no point in us going into a huddle and connecting as a group. We need to go and see the fans. So we want to spend that time and that moment with the fans.”

items.titleZh: 雷妮：“我们展现了战士般的表现”
items.summaryZh: 雷妮·斯莱格斯谈北伦敦德比逆转击败托特纳姆热刺。
bodyZh: 在周六客场2-1击败托特纳姆热刺后，雷妮·斯莱格斯在球员通道里满脸笑容。
凭借乔治娅·斯坦威和阿莱西亚·鲁索的进球，这位主教练带领球队在落后情况下实现逆转，全取三分并赢得了德比荣耀。
在回顾这场比赛时，她说道：“在北伦敦德比中全取三分，今天是为球迷而战。我为所有人感到高兴，尤其是为球迷，这就是为什么我们也要和他们一起庆祝。”
“今天拿到三分很不容易，这是一场苦战。比赛对我们要求很高，而且我们还在落后一球的情况下追赶。但我们展现出的方式、强度、斗志和团队性格，让我感到非常高兴。”
在谈到斯坦威的进球时——此前这位中场球员与奥利维亚·史密斯和鲁索进行了出色配合，雷妮接着说道：“很好，非常好。这太精彩了。我想这也是我们一直在讨论的。看到禁区内的空当，做出正确的决定，找出谁处于最佳射门位置。她们做得太棒了。我想是莱斯回敲给乔治娅的。这是一粒精彩的进球。”
下半场伊始鲁索通过点球帮助球队反超后，主教练对球队保护领先优势的表现感到满意，没有给热刺留下任何扳平的绝佳机会。
她说：“因为你知道只有一球的差距，托特纳姆热刺依然留在比赛中，今天整个团队展现出了一些战士般的拼搏表现。有几名球员为球队注入了活力。我认为凯特琳·福德表现得非常惊艳。乔治娅在中场，还有后防线。以及我们在最后阶段做出的决定。我们在需要的时候放慢了比赛节奏，走向角旗区，继续赢得对抗。真的非常高兴。”
比赛结束时，我们的一些球员本能地表达了内心的兴奋，她们跑向近4000名阿森纳球迷庆祝，随后才回到球场中央与对手握手。
谈到这种美妙的支持，雷妮表示：“对她们（球迷）来说这也是一段艰难的时期。但她们全部都来到了这里，客场看台座无虚席。她们一直支持着我们，陪我们度过整场比赛。所以我们觉得聚在一起围成一圈毫无意义。我们需要去见见球迷。所以我们想把那个时间和时刻留给球迷。”

items.summaryEn: Ben White will become the 119th player in our history to play 200 times when he features in our Premier League game against Everton
bodyEn: After being starting our Premier League game against Everton, Ben White reached 200 Arsenal appearances.
The defender has hit the landmark a little over five years after signing from Brighton & Hove Albion, becoming the 119th player in our history to reach the milestone number.

His double-century includes 171 starts and 29 appearances from the bench, during which he has scored seven goals, and assisted 17 others, including Gabriel's header in our 2-0 win against the Toffees.

That was his 143rd Premier League appearance for us, including 12 in last season's title-winning campaign, and his 32nd Champions League outing. Six more games have come in the FA Cup, while another 10 have been collected in the League Cup. He has also played seven Europa League matches, and he has two Community Shield titles alongside his Premier League winner's medal.
His 100th game for us came back in November 2023, while only Bukayo Saka, Gabriel and Martin Odegaard have more appearances than Ben in the current squad.

items.titleZh: 本·怀特达成阿森纳生涯200场里程碑
items.summaryZh: 本·怀特在对阵埃弗顿的英超比赛中迎来阿森纳生涯第200次出场。
bodyZh: 在对阵埃弗顿的英超比赛中首发登场后，本·怀特迎来了他的第200场阿森纳比赛。
这位后卫在从布莱顿加盟五年多后达成这一里程碑，成为了俱乐部历史上第119位达到这一里程碑的球员。
在他的200次出场中包括171次首发和29次替补登场，期间他攻入7球并送出17次助攻，其中包括在2-0战胜埃弗顿的比赛中助攻加布里埃尔头球破门。
这也是他为球队在英超联赛中的第143次出场（包括上赛季争冠征程中的12次），以及第32次欧冠出场。此外他还有6次足总杯出场、10次联赛杯出场、7次欧联杯出场，并且随队赢得了两个社区盾杯冠军和一个英超冠军。
他的第100场比赛是在2023年11月，在目前的球队阵容中，只有萨卡、加布里埃尔和厄德高的出场次数比本·怀特更多。

items.summaryEn: Our under-21s suffered endured a disappointing evening in Leicester
bodyEn: Our under-21s fell to a 4-1 defeat against Leicester City on Saturday night.
Luqman Aideed got the hosts off to the perfect start, netting the opener after five minutes, before Lorenz Hutchinson doubled the lead after half-time.
Hugo de Lisle and Admir Bristric doubled the Foxes' lead in a punishing second half, before Ceadach O'Neill netted a consolation for us.
FIRST HALF
Leicester started the game on the front foot and scored from their first meaningful opportunity when Aideed picked out the top corner with a clinical finish.
We came back into the game with a well-worked counter-attack, but Ife Ibrahim fired over the crossbar from the edge of the penalty area.
The Foxes continued to create chances, and almost had a second when Will Daniels rifled an effort from range towards goal, forcing an excellent save from Khari Ranson
Demiane Agustien came close at the end of what was an evenly-constested first half, but his well-struck effort was blocked in front of goal.
SECOND HALF
The hosts made a strong start to the second half, and doubled their lead with a clinical counter-attack, Hutchinson finishing off the move after a precise pass from Riley Carr.

Hutchinson came close to a quickfire double moments later, but although his effort was blocked by Brayden Clarke, the Foxes struck again from the resulting corner, with de Lisle rising highest to head home Tommy Neale's corner.

We made a triple change on the hour mark, with Andre Harriman-Annous, Igor Tyjon and O'Neill coming on. The change gave us more momentum in the game, and we threatened from a series of set pieces, O'Neill's effort from the edge of the box the closest we came to pulling one back in a confident spell.
But Carr's fluidity on the break once again undid us, with and Bristric was there to finish off a flowing Foxes move.
We pulled a goal back three minutes later when O'Neill picked out the bottom corner with a tidy finish, but it was no more than a consolation on a disappointing night in the East Midlands.
WHAT IT MEANS
Defeat in Leicestershire leaves us waiting for our first win of the Premier League two season, with four points from our first six games.
WHAT'S NEXT
Our under-21s are back in action in the EFL Trophy on Tuesday night with a trip to League One AFC Wimbledon on Tuesday night (6pm UK).

Subs: Hibbins, Anugo, Corden, Akolbire

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳U21梯队在客场以1比4不敌莱斯特城。
bodyZh: 阿森纳U21梯队在周六晚上的比赛中以1比4负于莱斯特城。
卢克曼·艾迪德开场仅5分钟就为 主队打破僵局，随后洛伦兹·哈钦森在下半场扩大了领先优势。
在严酷的下半场中，雨果·德利勒和阿德米尔·布里斯里奇为狐狸城扩大了比分，随后西达赫·奥尼尔为我们扳回一城。
上半场
莱斯特城开场攻势猛烈，并利用他们的第一次真正机会取得进球，艾迪德精准射门攻入球门死角。
我们通过一次配合流畅的反击重整旗鼓，但伊费·易卜拉欣禁区边缘的射门高出横梁。
狐狸城继续创造机会，威廉·丹尼尔斯远射几乎扩大比分，门将卡里·兰森做出精彩扑救。
在势均力敌的上半场尾声阶段，德米亚尼·阿古斯蒂恩险些破门，但他势大力沉的射门在门前被挡出。
下半场
主队下半场开局强劲，利用一次精准的反击扩大了比分，哈钦森接莱利·卡尔的精准传球完成破门。
片刻之后，哈钦森差一点梅开二度，尽管他的射门被布雷登·克拉克挡出，但狐狸城利用随后的角球再次得分，德利勒接汤姆·尼尔的角球头球破门。
我们在第60分钟做出三次换人调整，安德烈·哈里曼-安努斯、伊戈尔·泰永和奥尼尔替补登场。换人让我们在比赛中获得了更多势头，并通过一系列定位球制造了威胁，奥尼尔在禁区边缘的射门是我们在这段自信表现中最接近扳回一球的一次。
但卡尔在反击中的灵活跑动再次击溃了我们，布里斯里奇随后完成了一次流畅的进攻。
三分钟后，奥尼尔以一记精妙的射门攻入球门底角，为我们扳回一球，但这在东米德兰兹令人失望的夜晚只是个安慰。
这意味着什么
在莱斯特郡的失利意味着我们仍在等待英超二级联赛的首场胜利，前六场比赛积四分。
接下来
我们的U21梯队将于周二晚上重返赛场，参加EFL奖杯赛，客场对阵英甲球队温布尔登（英国时间周二晚上6点）。

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has expressed concern over Bukayo Saka’s robustness after a series of injuries to the forward in the past year and as he awaits further news on how long he will be out for with a thigh issue.

Saka is set for an MRI scan after limping off in the 2-2 draw with Bayern Munich in the Champions League, with Arteta revealing the 25-year-old had “quite a lot of fluid in the area so it was difficult to understand the extent of the injury”. Saka will definitely miss Saturday’s game against Evertonand, it is understood, Arsenal fear it could be a grade-two tear that could potentially keep him out for up to six weeks.

Saka missed a large portion of last season due to hamstring, hip and achilles tendon injuries having also been sidelined by another hamstring issue in 2024-25. In total, he has had 11 different injuries since September 2023 and Arteta insisted that he has been trying to ease his workload as a result. “It’s certainly been different in the last year or so,” the Spaniard said when asked if Saka remains robust enough to start every match. “The demands that we are putting on every player are immense. The amount of games, the intensity of those matches, the international competitions, the times as well between games are getting narrower.

“Bukayo against Lille [in the Champions League last week] didn’t start the game because we knew what was happening. We have to play three times in less than six days. And especially when the games are so demanding, until the last minute you are there, you are chasing the game, you want to win. The necessity is to win every game, so we know that. So we are preparing the players for those scenarios and we do the best that we possibly can.”

Saka missed only three Premier League matches in three seasons between 2021 and 2024 and broke the Arsenal club record by playing in 83 consecutive top-flight games. He is already approaching 300 appearances for the club he joined as a seven-year-old and was rewarded with a lucrative new contract in February that made him one of the highest-paid players in the club’s history.

Asked whether he feared Saka could suffer from burnout having made his Arsenal debut three months after his 17th birthday, Arteta said: “I don’t have that feeling at all but something we have to be very mindful of is to create the right ecosystem around the player to fulfil his qualities. We really need to understand, whenever he comes back, how we are going to manage his load, what he is capable of to sustain having an impact in the team.”

Saka had only three weeks off after the World Cup but Arteta rejected suggestions that he should have been given more We want to pick on something, we will find it, but we won’t know whether it is for that or not. Maybe we needed to load those tendons more during those three weeks? Because if you don’t load the tendons, it becomes a problem. Who knows? I don’t know.”

Saka’s absence could hand an opportunity to Max Dowman on Saturday. The 16-year-old has played only nine minutes in the league this season and Arteta feels sure he is ready to make an impact after he became the youngest goalscorer in Premier League history, against David Moyes’s side in March.

“There is something inevitable to go back to that memory and the feeling of the moment. That’s with us, that’s going to stay in that stadium for a long, long time,” said Arteta. “He’s training and every time he’s got a moment to play, he’s showing that he’s a player that is going to impact the game. For sure he’s going to have minutes.”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔担忧萨卡耐用性，锋线球员可能缺阵长达六周
items.summaryZh: 萨卡因大腿受伤面临核磁共振检查，阿森纳担心他可能缺阵长达六周。
bodyZh: 在经历了一系列伤病后，阿尔特塔对布卡约·萨卡的身体耐用性表达了担忧，目前球队正在等待其大腿伤势缺阵时间的进一步确诊。
在欧冠对阵拜仁慕尼黑的比赛中，萨卡因伤一瘸一拐地离场，并将接受核磁共振扫描。阿尔特塔透露，这位25岁球员的患处“有相当多的积液，因此很难了解伤势的严重程度”。萨卡将确定缺席周六对阵埃弗顿的比赛，据了解，阿森纳担心这可能是二级撕裂，可能导致他缺阵长达六周。

萨卡在上赛季因腿筋、髋关节和跟腱伤病缺席了大部分比赛，在2024-25赛季也曾受到另一次腿筋问题困扰。自2023年9月以来，他总共遭遇了11次不同的伤病，阿尔特塔坚称他因此一直在试图减轻萨卡的工作负荷。“在过去一年左右的时间里情况确实不同了，”当被问及萨卡是否仍然足够强壮以首发出战每场比赛时，这位西班牙主教练说道，“我们对每名球员提出的要求都是巨大的。比赛数量、比赛强度、国际赛事，以及比赛之间的时间间隔也越来越窄。”
“布卡约在上周对阵里尔的欧冠比赛中没有首发，因为我们知道发生了什么。我们在不到六天的时间里必须踢三场比赛。特别是当比赛要求如此之高时，直到最后一分钟你都在场上，你在追赶比分，你想要赢球。赢得每场比赛是必需的，我们对此很清楚。所以我们正在为这些情况让球员做好准备，我们已经尽了最大努力。”
在2021年至2024年的三个赛季中，萨卡仅缺席了三场英超比赛，并以连续出战83场顶级联赛打破了阿森纳俱乐部纪录。他即将迎来为这家7岁时加入的俱乐部出场的第300场比赛，并在2月获得了一份丰厚的新合同，使其成为俱乐部历史上收入最高的球员之一。
当被问及是否担心萨卡在17岁生日后三个月完成阿森纳首秀后会遭遇职业倦怠时，阿尔特塔表示：“我完全没有这种感觉，但我们需要非常注意的一点是，在球员周围创造正确的生态系统来发挥他的特质。无论他何时归来，我们确实需要了解将如何管理他的负荷，以及他有能力维持对球队的影响力。”
萨卡在世界杯后只有三周的假期，但阿尔特塔拒绝了本该给他更多假期的说法：“如果我们想挑出某个问题，我们总能找到它，但我们不会知道这是否是由此引起的。也许我们在那三周内需要给这些肌腱施加更多负荷？因为如果你不给肌腱施加负荷，它就会变成一个问题。谁知道呢？我不知道。”
萨卡的缺阵可能会在周六为马克斯·道曼提供机会。这位16岁小将在本赛季的联赛中仅出场9分钟，阿尔特塔确信他已经准备好产生影响，此前他在三月份对阵David Moyes球队的比赛中成为了英超历史最年轻的进球者。
“有些事情不可避免地会让人回想起那段记忆和当时的感受。这与我们同在，并将在这座球场里保留很长时间，”阿尔特塔说道。“他在训练中，而且每当获得出场时间时，他都表现出自己是一名能够对比赛产生影响的球员。他肯定会获得上场时间。”

bodyEn: Like him or not, there is no doubt that New York mayor Zohran Mamdani’s passion for certain issues is electric, and that passion played a large part in him getting elected. But today, two of his biggest passions are on a collision course.

On one hand, Mamdani is now arguably the US’s most high-profile supporter of English Premier League champions Arsenal. A superfan since he was a child, he has put the Gunners into the American spotlight more than anyone since becoming mayor. The Empire State Building gleamed in Arsenal’s red and white when they won the Premier League title. He wrote an essay about what Arsenal’s championship means to him, talks about Arsenal at press conferences and interviews and inaugurated Thierry Henry Way near Times Square in honor of the Arsenal legend.

But another of Mamdani’s passions – standing up against genocide and for human rights – is now presenting a problem for the mayor’s Arsenal fandom. One prominent part of Arsenal’s current image is deeply disturbing, and it presents a major opportunity for Mamdani.

Arsenal’s chief sponsor is Emirates Airlines, owned by the Emirates Group, a state-owned Dubai-based holding company. Emirates is on the front of every jersey, and the team plays at Emirates Stadium in London. The United Arab Emirates has spent more than $1bn sponsoring the team, including expanding its contract through 2033 to more than $100m per season. Arsenal is the UAE’s second biggest sports investment globally.

The trouble is the UAE is also sponsoring a genocidal militia in Sudan, where war has created the world’s largest displacement crisis, with 14 million people, or a quarter of the country’s population, forced to flee their homes, and 21 million people facing acute hunger. The UAE has provided the militia, known as the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), with weapons and killer drones, according to numerous investigations. In fact, the UAE is the RSF’s biggest supplier of weapons and drones.

And therein lies the rub. The UAE is engaging in one of the world’s largest sportswashing campaigns in an attempt to clean up its image, including with Mamdani’s beloved Arsenal. The UAE’s sportswashing isn’t limited to the Gunners. We calculated that the UAE government has spent more than $5.2bn on sponsoring sports teams and leagues around the world, including Manchester City, the NBA champion New York Knicks (a team Mamdani also cheers for), the Emirates NBA Cup and Formula One. There are multiple other football, basketball, cycling, rugby, cricket and UAE-sponsored teams as well.

The good news is that Arsenal’s ownership isn’t blind to abusive sportswashing relationships. Last year, the club announced it was cutting its sleeve sponsor, Visit Rwanda, after the country’s invasion of the Democratic Republic of Congo and the humanitarian catastrophe that ensued as a result. More than 8 million people have been displaced from their homes, as Rwanda has invaded the DRC and commanded the deadly M23 militia that has tortured victims, engaged in extensive sexual violence and enlisted child soldiers. The Arsenal Supporters’ Trust weighed in on the issue, following campaign initiatives such as Gunners for Peace, and the owners changed course.

Now it’s time for Arsenal to tackle their bigger sportswashing sponsor, and Mamdani can play a key role. As one of the world’s most visible Arsenal fans, his voice would have an important impact on the club’s decision makers. The club’s owners are American, Josh and Stan Kroenke, and they have stood up in the past for human rights – for instance, calling for a lifetime ban on former Los Angeles Clippers owner Don Sterling for making racist remarks.

Mamdani could make the Kroenkes and the rest of the Arsenal board aware of the UAE’s sportswashing and call on them either publicly or privately to move on to another sponsor because of the genocidal militia the UAE is sponsoring in Sudan. The club is, after all, awash in cash after winning the league and reaching the final of the Champions League, earning $411m in total, a record for Arsenal. It is now reportedly the most profitable football club in England. So they don’t need the Emirati money.

Importantly, the UAE is not the only game in town for football sponsors – there are viable alternatives. Snapdragon, a Qualcomm tech company, pays approximately the same amount for sponsoring Manchester United as the Emirates pays Arsenal, and automaker Jeep and telecom company T-Mobile pay Juventus and Bayern Munich just a hair under.

Arsenal canceling the deal would also have a meaningful impact on the UAE and on the genocide unfolding in Sudan. The UAE is very sensitive to public image, and a cancelled Arsenal deal would be a major public relations blow. Mamdani’s intervention could have major human rights implications.

Mamdani is passionate about human rights, combating genocide and supporting his favorite team. Urging the club’s leadership to change its sponsor from the UAE would combine all three passions into one and potentially have a positive impact on the world’s deadliest humanitarian crisis. New Yorkers and Arsenal fans alike should encourage Mamdani to weigh in with the club on this important issue.
Sasha Lezhnev is Senior Policy Advisor at The Sentry, where John Prendergast is Co-Founder.

items.titleZh: 马姆达尼热爱阿森纳，他应当敦促俱乐部因苏丹问题切断与阿联酋的联系
items.summaryZh: 纽约市长马姆达尼对阿森纳的热爱与对人权的关注形成碰撞，这为其推动阿森纳终止阿联酋赞助提供了契机。
bodyZh: 无论你是否喜欢他，毫无疑问，纽约市长佐兰·马姆达尼对某些议题的热情是极具感染力的，正是这种热情在很大程度上帮助他赢得了选举。但如今，他的两大最大热情正处于一场碰撞之中。
一方面，马姆达尼可以说是美国最受关注的英超冠军阿森纳的超级支持者。作为一名从小到大的死忠球迷，他在当选市长后，将这支枪手球队带入了前所未有的美国聚光灯下。当阿森纳赢得英超冠军时，帝国大厦亮起了阿森纳的红白两色。他曾撰文讲述阿森纳的夺冠对他的意义，在记者会和采访中谈论阿森纳，并为了致敬这位阿森纳传奇，在时代广场附近为蒂埃里·亨利路（Thierry Henry Way）举行了揭牌仪式。
但马姆达尼的另一大热情——反对种族灭绝、捍卫人权——如今却为这位市长的阿森纳球迷身份带来了一个难题。阿森纳当前形象中一个显眼的组成部分令人深感不安，这也为马姆达尼带来了一个重大契机。
阿森纳的主要赞助商是阿联酋航空（Emirates Airlines），该公司隶属于总部位于迪拜的国有控股公司阿联酋航空集团。阿联酋航空的标志印在每件球衣的正面，球队在伦敦的酋长球场比赛。阿联酋已花费超过10亿美元赞助该球队，其中包括将合同延长至2033年、每赛季超过1.0亿美元的赞助。阿森纳是阿联酋在全球范围内的第二大体育投资。
问题在于，阿联酋同时也在苏丹资助一支实施种族灭绝的民兵武装。那里的战争引发了全球最大的流离失所危机，有1400万人（即该国四分之一的人口）被迫逃离家园，2100万人面临严重饥荒。多项调查显示，阿联酋向被称为快速支援部队（RSF）的民兵武装提供了武器和致命无人机。事实上，阿联酋正是该武装最大的武器和无人机供应商。

问题也恰恰在于此。阿联酋正在进行全球最大规模的“体育洗白”运动之一，企图以此改善自身形象，对象也包括马姆达尼深爱的阿森纳。阿联酋的体育洗白并不局限于枪手。据我们计算，阿联酋政府已在赞助全球各地的体育球队和联赛上花费超过52亿美元，包括曼城、NBA冠军纽约尼克斯队（这也是马姆达尼支持的一支球队）、阿联酋航空NBA杯以及一级方程式赛车。此外还有多支涉及足球、篮球、自行车、橄榄球、板球等由阿联酋赞助的队伍。

好消息是，阿森纳的所有权层并非对有害的体育洗白关系视而不见。去年，该俱乐部宣布在卢旺达入侵刚果民主共和国并引发人道主义灾难后，终止其球衣袖标赞助商“visit Rwanda”的合作。由于卢旺达入侵刚果民主共和国并指挥了残害受害者、大范围实施性暴力以及招募童兵的致命M23民兵武装，已有超过800万人流离失所。在“枪手争取和平”等球迷运动的推动下，阿森纳球迷信托基金（Arsenal Supporters’ Trust）也就此问题发声，随后俱乐部所有者改变了方针。
现在是阿森纳处理其规模更大的体育洗白赞助商的时候了，而马姆达尼可以发挥关键作用。作为世界上最受瞩目的阿森纳球迷之一，他的声音将对俱乐部的决策者产生重要影响。俱乐部的所有者是美国的乔什和斯坦·克伦克，他们过去曾为支持人权挺身而出——例如，曾因前洛杉矶快船队老板唐·斯特林发表种族歧视言论而呼吁对其实施终身禁赛。
马姆达尼可以促使克伦克家族以及阿森纳董事会的其他成员意识到阿联酋的体育洗白行为，并公开或私下呼吁他们由于阿联酋在苏丹资助种族灭绝民兵而更换赞助商。毕竟，在赢得联赛冠军并打入欧冠决赛、总共获得411万美元（创下阿森纳纪录）的收入后，该俱乐部目前资金充裕。据报道，它现在是英格兰最具盈利能力的足球俱乐部。因此，他们并不需要阿联酋的资金。
重要的是，阿联酋并不是足球赞助商的唯一选择——市场上存在可行的替代方案。高通旗下的科技公司骁龙（Snapdragon）为赞助曼联支付了与阿联酋航空赞助阿森纳大致相当的金额，汽车制造商吉普和电信公司T-Mobile对尤文图斯和拜仁慕尼黑的赞助金额也仅略低一点。
阿森纳取消这项协议也将对阿联酋以及苏丹正在发生的一场种族灭绝产生实质性影响。阿联酋对公众形象非常敏感，取消阿森纳的赞助协议将对其公共关系造成重大打击。马姆达尼的干预可能会对人权产生重大影响。
马姆达尼对人权充满热忱、致力于打击种族灭绝并支持自己最喜爱的球队。敦促俱乐部领导层将赞助商从阿联酋更换，将这三者热忱合为一体，并有可能对全球最致命的人道主义危机产生积极影响。纽约人和阿森纳球迷都应该鼓励马姆达尼在这个重要议题上向俱乐部施加影响。
萨沙·莱日涅夫（Sasha Lezhnev）是“哨兵组织”（The Sentry）的高级政策顾问，约翰·普伦德加斯特（John Prendergast）是该组织的联合创始人。

bodyEn: After seven games, Nottingham Forest’s record is eerily similar to last season: five points, five goals scored. A year ago Forest’s eighth game was a 3-0 home loss to Chelsea that marked the end for Ange Postecoglou, the second of four managers to occupy the dugout last term. There is no suggestion that Oliver Glasner is under similar scrutiny yet, but the Austrian needs to find solutions for the league’s lowest scorers. Morgan Gibbs-White is available after missing the narrow defeat by Arsenal, while Liam Delap may benefit from a return to familiar surroundings – 12 of his 14 career Premier League goals were scored for Ipswich, six of them at Portman Road. “What we need to improve is getting [Delap] into more positions where he can score,” Glasner said before Friday evening’s game. “He’s one of our best finishers.” Gary O’Neil also lacks a standout scorer, but he is squeezing goals out of his side. Eight different Ipswich players have scored in seven games; only Brighton and Brentford can better that total this season. Niall McVeigh
Ipswich v Nottingham Forest, Friday 8pm BST

It was five months ago but it feels a lot longer. When these two sides met in May to finish the season, the contest doubled as Pep Guardiola’s leaving party after 10 years in the job and twice as many trophies, an era now laden with asterisks. It must be surreal for Aston Villa supporters, too. Their 2-1 victory at the Etihad Stadium, inspired by two goals from Ollie Watkins to complete a league double over City, came only four days after their Europa League triumph in Istanbul, where Youri Tielemans, Morgan Rogers and Emi Buendía were the scorers. Buendía is the only one left in claret and blue as Unai Emery builds a new side, one that has picked up in form after a single point from their first four league games. City, meanwhile, are thriving on the pitch: victory would make them just the third side to win their first eight games of a Premier League season. Taha Hashim
Aston Villa v Manchester City, Saturday 12.30pm BST

Max Dowman became the youngest goalscorer in Premier League history with his dazzling solo strike against Everton at the Emirates in March. But the supremely talented 16-year-old has found opportunities limited this season. Dowman has played only nine minutes in the Premier League despite scoring twice against Ipswich in the Carabao Cup last month as Arsenal have tried to protect their rising star. Yet the suspected quad muscle injury suffered by Bukayo Saka in Wednesday’s 2-2 Champions League draw at Bayern Munich means Mikel Arteta is short of attacking options. With David Moyes’s side back in north London, it could be the perfect chance for Dowman to step up in his favoured position on the right flank. Ed Aarons
Arsenal v Everton, Saturday 3pm BST

Coventry and Fulham have only met twice in the English top flight – back in 1967-68, when the promoted Sky Blues took a single point from two meetings, but stayed up by a point while Fulham went down. It is too early to call Saturday’s game a six-pointer in the relegation battle, but the two teams sit either side of the dreaded dotted line after shaky starts. Coventry have shown glimpses of their Championship swagger, particularly in the 4-1 rout of Newcastle, but Frank Lampard wants his players to start thinking like a Premier League team. “I can’t keep applauding the players, believing they deserve to be here,” the Coventry manager said. “Now we have to get over that. We can’t be too soft.” Sunderland, Crystal Palace and Ipswich all visit the CBS Arena in the coming weeks, so there is an opportunity to consolidate. Fulham were linked with Lampard in the summer, and questions remain over whether Álvaro Arbeloa is pragmatic or flexible enough to succeed. Will these sides meet in the Premier League again next season? The jury is out. NM
Coventry v Fulham, Saturday 3pm BST

Tottenham’s recent record against Chelsea is miserable. They are on a six-match losing streak against their London rivals and have collected a paltry two points at Stamford Bridge since last winning there in April 2018. Tottenham finally have a league win – they beat Coventry 3-1 on Monday – but remain unconvincing. Roberto De Zerbi used a 3-4-2-1 system against Coventry. He had problems in midfield but now has to work out whether to change a winning team. Does he stick with James Maddison after the No 10’s excellent goal against his boyhood club? Spurs still looked short of energy at times. There is an argument to bring back Conor Gallagher’s dynamism, but would that hurt the side’s quality on the ball? Mateus Fernandes is another option but is yet to establish himself since joining from West Ham. Spurs’ approach remains hard to decipher. De Zerbi likes possession, but Chelsea want teams to open up as the Blues have searing pace on the break. Given their history in this fixture it seems Spurs should focus on tightening up. Equally they can’t be passive and need a threat on the break. De Zerbi will be searching for the right balance. Jacob Steinberg
Chelsea v Tottenham, Saturday 5.30pm BST

Talk of Brighton achieving Champions League qualification for the first time will gain more credence, even at this early stage, should Fabian Hürzeler’s confident side extend their unbeaten run to nine matches in all competitions. There have been six clean sheets and 23 goals scored in sequence that featured six wins in a row and the Premier League’s highest scorers will take encouragement from Liverpool’s defensive problems in the comeback against Villarreal, which were not limited to Virgil van Dijk’s early lapses. Andoni Iraola is yet to savour a first home league win as Liverpool head coach – Anfield has seen only four home wins in 13 league games this year – and he will be wary of Brighton’s various threats. But with Rio Ngumoha electric in the Champions League win, Florian Wirtz improving and Alexander Isak increasingly decisive, the ingredients are in place for another enthralling spectacle. Andy Hunter
Sign up to Football Daily
Kick off your evenings with the Guardian's take on the world of football
after newsletter promotion
Liverpool v Brighton, Sunday 2pm GMT

Who can or will lift Manchester United after the latest dismal/embarrassing week? Bruno Fernandes’s abdication of captaincy duties – accusing his manager of being tactically inept – showed what a rabble the team has become under Michael Carrick; and beyond the double footballer of the year, is there another star act who can win a game? Bournemouth will hope to take advantage, register only a second league win of the season, and deepen the misery for their hosts and fans. If his side goes down to the Cherries, Carrick will surely follow: the latest victim of the United circus. Jamie Jackson
Manchester United v Bournemouth, Sunday 2pm GMT

It’s been six months since Crystal Palace recorded a clean sheet in the Premier League at Selhurst Park and the pressure will be on Pierre Sage against Newcastle on Sunday. Palace have conceded eight goals in four home league games this season, although they welcome back Axel Disasi from suspension after his reckless red card against Ipswich. The French defender was brought in on loan from Chelsea to add experience but cost Palace in the defeat by the newly-promoted side and had to watch from the sidelines as the Eagles were humiliated against Brighton last weekend. Disasi owes Sage a favour and he will be desperate to make up for his poor start to life in south London. EA
Crystal Palace v Newcastle, Sunday 2pm GMT

Something unusual will happen at the MKM Stadium on Sunday; either Hull City or Brentford will register more than 50% possession. In seven league games, Brentford only had more of the ball in their 1-1 draw at Leeds. The hosts, meanwhile, are comfortably the most possession-averse team in the top flight so far this season, at an average of just over 30%. Both teams have been effective on the break and successful at set-pieces, with three goals apiece from dead balls. This may prove to be a match for the purists, where one clinical moment makes the difference. The Bees head coach, Keith Andrews, will hope it comes from Igor Thiago, yet to recapture the prolific form of last season. “Thiago at the moment is a very marked man, but we’ve got goalscorers throughout the team,” Andrews said of the Brazilian forward, who has scored one goal in seven this season. “Thiago being Thiago wants to score more goals, and he’s certainly not far away.” NM
Hull v Brentford, Sunday 2pm GMT

Nordi Mukiele ranks among Sunderland’s best players and most influential dressing-room figures. Tellingly the former Paris Saint-Germain defender has been scathing about his team’s dismal start to the Premier League campaign and expects a reaction when Leeds visit Wearside on Sunday. “Leeds will be the right moment to show everyone we are not dead,” says Mukiele, well aware that Régis Le Bris’s side start this weekend on the bottom of the table. “We have not been good enough. Right now it’s not us; we are not Sunderland. I believe we can go back to the top. I believe in this team and this staff. We have quality.” Sunderland must use their three league fixtures before the international break – Leeds, Coventry away and Chelsea at home – to remind everyone why they finished seventh last season. Louise Taylor
Sunderland v Leeds, Sunday 4.30pm GMT

items.titleZh: 英超周末看点：阿森纳迎战埃弗顿，热刺客场挑战切尔西
items.summaryZh: 萨卡受伤缺阵或给道曼带来机会，阿森纳本周末将在主场对阵埃弗顿。
bodyZh: 在踢了七场比赛后，诺丁汉森林的战绩与上赛季惊人地相似：积五分，打进五球。一年前，森林队的第八场比赛是在主场0比3输给切尔西，这标志着安格·波斯特科格鲁执教生涯的结束，他也是上赛季四位主帅中的第二位。目前没有任何迹象表明奥利弗·格拉斯纳正面临着类似的压力，但这位奥地利主帅需要为这支联赛进球最少的球队找到解决办法。摩根·吉布斯-怀特在缺席了对阵阿森纳的小负后本场可登场，而利亚姆·德拉普重回熟悉的环境可能会有所斩获——在他职业生涯的14个英超进球中，有12个是为伊普斯维奇打进的，其中6个在波特曼路球场。“我们需要改进的是让（德拉普）进入更多能够进球的位置，”格拉斯纳在周五晚上的比赛前说道。“他是我们最好的终结者之一。”加里·奥尼尔同样缺乏一个突出的射手，但他正在从球队中压榨出进球。八名不同的伊普斯维奇球员在七场比赛中都有进球；本赛季只有布赖顿和布伦特福德能超越这一总数。尼尔·麦克维（Niall McVeigh）
伊普斯维奇对阵诺丁汉森林，周五晚上8点（英国夏令时）

那是五个月前的事了，但感觉要长得多。当这两支球队在5月相遇以结束赛季时，这场比赛也是佩普·瓜迪奥拉在执教10年、赢得两倍于此的奖杯后的告别派对，这是一个如今带有星号的时代。对于阿斯顿维拉球迷来说，这也一定很不真实。他们在阿提哈德球场2比1获胜，奥利·沃特金斯的两个进球帮助他们完成了对曼城的联赛双杀，这距离他们在伊斯坦布尔的欧联杯胜利仅仅过去四天，当时尤里·蒂勒曼斯、摩根·罗杰斯和埃米·布恩迪亚取得了进球。随着埃梅里打造一支新球队，布恩迪亚是酒红色军团中唯一留下来的人，这支球队在联赛前四场比赛只拿到一分后，状态已经有所回升。与此同时，曼城在球场上蒸蒸日上：如果取胜，他们将成为英超联赛历史上第三支赢得赛季前八场比赛的球队。塔哈·哈希姆（Taha Hashim）
阿斯顿维拉对阵曼城，周六中午12点30分（英国夏令时）

今年3月在酋长球场对阵埃弗顿的比赛中，马克斯·道曼凭借惊艳的个人表演破门，成为了英超历史上最年轻的进球者。但这位天赋异禀的16岁球员本赛季的出场机会有限。尽管上个月在联赛杯对阵伊普斯维奇时梅开二度，但阿森纳为了保护这位新星，道曼在英超联赛中仅出场了9分钟。然而，布卡约·萨卡周三在慕尼黑以2比2战平拜仁的欧冠比赛中疑似大腿肌肉受伤，这意味着米克尔·阿尔特塔在进攻端的选择捉襟见肘。随着大卫·莫耶斯的球队重返北伦敦，这可能是道曼在其最喜欢的右边锋位置上挺身而出的绝佳机会。埃德·阿伦斯（Ed Aarons）
阿森纳对阵埃弗顿，周六下午3点（英国夏令时）

考文垂和富勒姆在英格兰顶级联赛中只交手过两次——早在1967-68赛季，当时升班马天蓝色军团从两次交锋中只拿到一分，但最终凭借一分保级，而富勒姆则降级了。现在就把周六的比赛称为保级战中的“六分之战”还为时过早，但在经历了一个动荡的开局后，这两支球队都坐在那条可怕的虚线两侧。考文垂展现出了他们在英冠联赛中的风采，特别是在4比1大胜纽卡斯尔的比赛中，但弗兰克·兰帕德希望他的球员开始像一支英超球队那样思考。“我不能一直为球员鼓掌，认为他们配得上留在这里，”考文垂主帅说。“现在我们必须克服这一点。我们不能太软弱。”桑德兰、水晶宫和伊普斯维奇将在未来几周造客理查德森球场，因此这是一个巩固排名的机会。富勒姆在夏天与兰帕德联系在一起，关于阿尔瓦罗·阿尔韦亚拉是否足够务实或灵活以取得成功，仍存疑问。下赛季这两支球队还会再次在英超相遇吗？目前尚无定论。NM
考文垂对阵富勒姆，周六下午3点（英国夏令时）

热刺最近对阵切尔西的战绩相当糟糕。他们对阵这个伦敦死敌遭遇了六连胜（注：原文如此，即热刺对切尔西六连败），自从2018年4月在那里取胜以来，他们在斯坦福桥仅仅拿到了可怜的两分。热刺终于迎来了一场联赛胜利——他们在周一以3比1击败了考文垂——但表现依然不够令人信服。罗伯托·德泽尔比在对阵考文垂时使用了3-4-2-1阵型。他在中场遇到了问题，现在必须考虑是否要改变一支赢球的球队。在10号球员对阵他儿时效力的俱乐部打进精彩进球后，他还会继续信任詹姆斯·麦迪逊吗？热刺有时看起来仍然缺乏活力。有一种观点认为应该重新启用康纳·加拉格尔的活力，但这会损害球队在控球方面的质量吗？马特乌斯·费尔南德斯是另一个选择，但自从从西汉姆联加盟以来，他尚未确立自己的地位。热刺的战术方针仍然难以捉摸。德泽尔比喜欢控球，但切尔西希望对手阵型拉开，因为蓝军在反击中速度极快。鉴于他们在这场对决中的历史，热刺似乎应该专注于收缩防守。同样，他们也不能被动，在反击中需要保持威胁。德泽尔比将寻找正确的平衡。雅各布·斯坦伯格（Jacob Steinberg）
切尔西对阵热刺，周六下午5点30分（英国夏令时）

如果法比安·赫泽勒这支充满自信的球队将各项赛事的不败纪录扩大到九场，那么关于布赖顿首次获得欧冠资格的言论将会获得更多可信度，尽管目前还为时尚早。在这一系列比赛中，布赖顿取得了六场零封和23个进球，其中包括六连胜，作为英超进球最多的球队，逆转战胜比利亚雷亚尔时暴露出的利物浦防守问题（不仅限于范戴克的早期失误）将给他们带来鼓舞。安多尼·伊劳拉作为利物浦主教练还未尝到主场联赛首胜的滋味——今年安菲尔德在13场联赛中只取得了4场主场胜利——他将对布赖顿的各种威胁保持警惕。但随着里奥·恩古莫哈在欧冠胜利中表现惊艳、弗洛里安·维尔茨不断进步以及亚历山大·伊萨克发挥越来越决定性的作用，另一场扣人心弦的比赛已经具备了所有要素。安迪·H（Andy Hunter）

利物浦对阵布赖顿，周日晚上2点（格林威治标准时间）

在经历了又一个惨淡/尴尬的一周后，谁能够或将振奋曼联？布鲁诺·费尔南德斯放弃队长职责——指责他的主教练战术无能——这表明在迈克尔·卡里克的带领下，这支球队已经变成了一盘散沙；除了这位双料足球先生之外，还有哪位球星能够赢得一场比赛？伯恩茅斯希望利用这一点，取得本赛季的第二场联赛胜利，并加深主队及其球迷的痛苦。如果他的球队输给樱桃军团，卡里克肯定会随之下课：成为曼联马戏团的最新牺牲品。杰米·杰克逊（Jamie Jackson）
曼联对阵伯恩茅斯，周日晚上2点（格林威治标准时间）

距离水晶宫在塞尔赫斯特公园球场完成一场英超零封已经过去六个月了，周日对阵纽卡斯尔的比赛中，皮埃尔·萨奇将承受压力。本赛季水晶宫在四个主场联赛中已经丢了八球，尽管他们在经历对阵伊普斯维奇的鲁莽红牌禁赛后，迎来了阿克塞尔·迪萨西的回归。这位法国后卫是从切尔西租借引进的，旨在增加经验，但在输给这支升班马的比赛中付出了代价，并且只能在场边看着老鹰军团上周末被布赖顿羞辱。迪萨西欠萨奇一个人情，他将极力弥补自己在南伦敦糟糕的开局。EA
水晶宫对阵纽卡斯尔，周日晚上2点（格林威治标准时间）

周日，MKM球场将发生一件不同寻常的事情；赫尔城或布伦特福德其中一方的控球率将超过50%。在七场联赛中，布伦特福德只有在客场1比1战平利兹联时控球率占优。与此同时，主队是本赛季至今顶级联赛中最不愿控球的球队，平均控球率仅略高于30%。两支球队在反击中都非常高效，在定位球上也取得了成功，各有三个定位球破门。这或许会是一场属于纯粹主义者的比赛，一个门前绝杀的瞬间将决定胜负。蜂群军团主教练基思·安德鲁斯希望这能由伊戈尔·蒂亚戈来完成，尽管他尚未重现上赛季多产的状态。“蒂亚戈目前是一个备受瞩目的球员，但我们全队都有进球手，”安德鲁斯谈到这位本赛季七场比赛打进一球的巴西前锋时说道。“蒂亚戈作为他自己，想要打进更多进球，他距离那并不遥远。”NM
赫尔城对阵布伦特福德，周日晚上2点（格林威治标准时间）

诺迪·穆基莱是桑德兰最好的球员和更衣室最具影响力的人物之一。这位前巴黎圣日耳曼后卫对球队在英超联赛中惨淡的开局进行了严厉批评，并期待在周日利兹联造访威尔赛德时做出强烈的反应。“对阵利兹联将是向所有人证明我们还没有死去的最佳时机，”穆基莱说道，他清楚地知道雷吉斯·勒布里斯的球队在本周末开始时排名积分榜垫底。“我们的表现还不够好。现在的我们不是真正的我们；我们不是桑德兰。我相信我们能重返巅峰。我信任这支球队和教练组。我们具备实力。”桑德兰必须利用国际比赛日前的三场联赛——对阵利兹联、客场对阵考文垂以及主场对阵切尔西——来提醒所有人他们上赛季为何能排名第七。路易斯·泰勒（Louise Taylor）
桑德兰对阵利兹联，周日下午4点30分（英国夏令时）
