bodyEn: For Bruno Guimarães, it was a time to show his steeliness, to fix his eyes on the prize – even if he knew it would surely mean them welling up. And then some. It was a tumultuous summer for the Brazil midfielder. A fine World Cup on a personal level was marred by a crucial penalty miss in the last-16 loss against Norway. Now he had the dream move lined up to Arsenal but it could not happen without breaking some hearts at Newcastle.

Guimarães admits he lay awake at night as the emotions swirled. How could he leave Newcastle, the club where he made so many connections and enjoyed so many highs after joining from Lyon in January 2022? There were the Champions League qualifications and, above all, the Carabao Cup triumph in 2025 that ended a 70-year wait for a domestic trophy. On the other hand, how could he resist Arsenal and the prospect of competing regularly for the game’s top honours?

Sometimes, you simply have to take a deep breath and the plunge. Nobody wants to die wondering. Guimarães knew the Newcastle team was breaking up. Anthony Gordon and Sandro Tonali had gone to Barcelona and Tottenham. The manager, Eddie Howe, was at the end of the line and would also leave. Guimarães went through with the £75m transfer and nobody can say it has not worked out so far.

Arsenal felt he would provide a different element for them, different ways of unlocking defences, plus his trademark work rate and snarl. Guimarães has brought all of that. Already he has made a difference. He even gave a little back to Newcastle when he scored his first Arsenal goal at Sunderland in September, paving the way for a 2-0 victory. Two Premier League games later, he scored the winner at home against Leeds.

Guimarães almost got another vital goal on Wednesday in the Champions League tie at Bayern Munich only for Manuel Neuer to deny him with an outrageous save. That would have put Arsenal 2-1 up. The game finished 2-2, Arsenal fighting until the end and equalising through Declan Rice in the 82nd minute. Still, it has not been easy for Guimarães and he surely has Arsenal’s visit to Newcastle on 21 November circled in his diary. His greatest hope is that he can build the same relationships at his new club.

“It was not just hard to tell Eddie but to tell the owners and my teammates [about deciding to leave Newcastle],” Guimarães says. “But I think the club went to a new rotation; a lot of players left, as well. The gaffer left. It was tough because my connection with the club was unbelievable. I never felt so loved like the way I was at Newcastle. I hope I can have the same love here at Arsenal.

“It was hard for me to say bye. I remember when I said bye to the lads, I was crying. They were crying as well because we were a family there. I lost many, many nights of sleep because it was difficult for me, for my family. But sometimes in your life you have to make decisions and in my mind, I needed a new challenge. I wish Newcastle all the best because they were so nice to me. It is just time to move on and I’ve been enjoying my time here at Arsenal, as well.”

Guimarães is enjoying his burgeoning midfield partnership with Rice, not to mention Martin Ødegaard, who tends to be the most advanced of the trio. That said, there is plenty of fluidity between the positions. There is the sense that the manager, Mikel Arteta, is searching for the perfect balance.

“Declan can play – like me – as a No 6, No 8 or No 10,” Guimarães says. “The manager is still trying to get the best version of ourselves. Against Bayern, I played more as a No 6, Declan played more as a No 8. I enjoy playing with him a lot; with Martin, as well. We have been on a good run so far.”

Guimarães’ battles when he was at Newcastle against Rice have been well documented. He said Rice had messaged him as he prepared to sign for Arsenal, saying: “No more fights, now we’re friends.” Guimarães is the player you loathe when he is against you but love when he is in your ranks.

What was the worst thing Guimarães said to Rice when they were in opposition? “It is difficult to say,” he replies with a smile. “I am like this when I play against teams. When we were playing against each other, I was not nice to him, he was not nice to me! Now we try to help each other on the pitch.”

Guimarães cannot believe how Neuer kept out his close-range header; the 40-year-old goalkeeper clawed the ball up against the crossbar and away. “He pulled off a miracle,” Guimarães says. “I asked him after the game: ‘How did you manage to save that?’ He said: ‘I don’t know. I just saved it!’ He’s unbelievable, one of the best keepers in the world. No matter how old he is, he is top.”

What Guimarães has seen with clarity is the remorselessness of the collective attitude at Arsenal; the insatiable will to win, which comes from Arteta. Next up for them is Everton at home on Saturday. Guimarães knows he is in the right place.

“The mentality of the club has changed a lot and Arteta shows this perfectly,” Guimarães says. “We don’t accept a draw at Bayern. We always want to win. That is the mentality that we go to the training ground with every day. Arteta is always a little bit addicted to videos and the way that he can make us feel better on the pitch. We have a top manager with a top mentality. We want to win everything possible.”

items.titleZh: 吉马良斯转会阿森纳前曾失眠，希望在枪手收获同样的情感
items.summaryZh: 吉马良斯谈离开纽卡斯尔时的不舍与泪水，并展望在阿森纳的新挑战。
bodyZh: 对于布鲁诺·吉马良斯来说，这是一个展现钢铁意志、锁定目标的时刻——即便他深知这必然会让人眼眶湿润。甚至远不止于此。对这位巴西中场而言，这是一个动荡的夏天。世界杯上个人的高光表现因十六强赛对阵挪威时罚失关键点球而蒙上阴影。如今，他迎来了梦想中的阿森纳转会，但这不可避免地会伤透纽卡斯尔球迷的心。
吉马良斯坦言，在百感交集之际，他曾夜不能寐。自从2022年1月从里昂加盟以来，他在纽卡斯尔建立了深厚的联系并收获了无数高光时刻，他又怎能轻易离开？这里有欧冠资格，最重要的是2025年夺得联赛杯冠军，结束了国内赛事冠军长达70年的等待。另一方面，他又怎能拒绝阿森纳以及持续竞逐足坛最高荣誉的前景？
有时，你不得不深吸一口气然后纵身一跃。没有人愿意带着遗憾离去。吉马良斯知道纽卡斯尔的阵容正在解体。安东尼·戈登和桑德罗·托纳利已经分别加盟巴塞罗那和托特纳姆热刺。主教练埃迪·霍夫也走到了十字路口并即将离任。吉马良斯最终完成了这笔7500万英镑的转会，目前看来所有人都觉得物有所值。
阿森纳认为他能为球队提供不同的战术元素、多种破解密集防守的方式，以及他标志性的拼劲与强硬。吉马良斯带来了这一切。他已经带来了改变。9月份在桑德兰打进自己加盟阿森纳的首球时，他甚至还顺势“回馈”了纽卡斯尔一番，为2-0的胜利铺平了道路。两场英超比赛过后，他又在主场对阵利兹联的比赛中攻入制胜球。
周三在慕尼黑进行的欧冠比赛中，吉马良斯差点攻入一记关键进球，但被诺伊尔神勇化解。那本可以帮助阿森纳取得2-1的领先。最终比赛以2-2收场，阿森纳战斗到最后一刻，由赖斯在第82分钟扳平比分。尽管如此，吉马良斯的适应并非一帆风顺，他在日历上肯定圈出了11月21日阿森纳客场挑战纽卡斯尔的比赛。他最大的希望是在新俱乐部建立同样的深厚情谊。
“不仅是告诉埃迪，告诉俱乐部高层和队友（决定离开纽卡斯尔）都非常艰难，”吉马良斯说，“但我认为俱乐部进入了一个新的周期，很多球员也离开了。主教练也离开了。这很艰难，因为我和这家俱乐部的联系太不可思议了。我从未感受到像在纽卡斯尔时那样被深爱着。我希望能在阿森纳得到同样的爱。”
“对我说再见很难。我记得跟队友们道别时我在哭。他们也在哭，因为我们在那里就像一家人。我和家人失眠了很多很多个夜晚，因为这实在太难了。但生活中有时必须做出抉择，在我看来，我需要一个新的挑战。祝纽卡斯尔一切都顺利，因为他们对我太好了。现在是时候向前看，我也很享受在阿森纳的时光。”
吉马良斯很享受他与赖斯日益默契的中场搭档关系，更不用说厄德高了，后者往往是三人组中最靠前的那一个。话虽如此，这几个位置之间有着极高的流动性。人们能感觉到主教练米克尔·阿尔特塔正在寻找完美的平衡。
“赖斯可以踢——就像我一样——6号位、8号位或10号位，”吉马良斯说，“教练仍在努力让我们发挥出最佳状态。对阵拜仁时，我踢得更靠后担任6号位，赖斯踢的是8号位。我非常享受和他一起踢球，与马丁（厄德高）也是如此。到目前为止，我们的状态保持得不错。”
吉马良斯过去在纽卡斯尔与赖斯的对抗有目共睹。他透露，当他准备签约阿森纳时，赖斯曾发信息对他说：“不再有对抗了，现在我们是朋友。”吉马良斯就是那种作为对手时让你恨之入骨、而成为队友时让你爱不释手的球员。

吉马良斯在场上作为对手时对赖斯说过最糟糕的话是什么？他笑着回答：“这很难说。我跟球队交手时就是这样。当我们互为对手时，我对并不他客气，他对我也毫不客气！现在我们在球场上努力互相帮助。”
吉马良斯简直不敢相信诺伊尔是如何封堵出他近距离头球攻门的；这位40岁的门将单掌将球拍向横梁并化解了险情。“他完成了一次神迹，”吉马良斯说，“赛后我问他：‘你怎么能扑出那个球的？’他说：‘我不知道！我就是扑出去了！’他太不可思议了，是世界上最好的门将之一。无论他多大年龄，他都是顶级水平。”
吉马良斯清晰地看到的是阿森纳全队冷酷无情的整体态度；那种对胜利的极度渴望，源自于阿尔特塔。他们接下来将于周六在主场迎战埃弗顿。吉马良斯深知自己来对了地方。
“俱乐部的精神面貌发生了很大变化，阿尔特塔完美地展现了这一点，”吉马良斯说，“我们在慕尼黑不接受平局。我们总是渴望取胜。这就是我们每天带着去训练基地的精神。阿尔特塔总是有点‘视频痴迷’，他总能通过各种方式让我们在场上感觉更好。我们拥有一位心态顶级的顶级主帅。我们想要赢得所有可能的冠军。”

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta made no attempt to conceal his concern over the quad injury that forced Bukayo Saka out of Arsenal’s 2-2 Champions League draw at Bayern Munich, saying it did not “look good at all”.

The manager was delighted with the fight that his players showed, Declan Rice earning a deserved point with an 82nd-minute equaliser. Arsenal had led through Eberechi Eze, who came on in the 10th minute for the stricken Saka, before Harry Kane took centre stage. The Bayern striker set up Alphonso Davies for 1-1 before giving his team the lead from the penalty spot.

It was Saka’s setback that provided the sour note for Arsenal. He collapsed to the turf after a routine battle with Davies and walked off slowly after treatment. Saka was still moving in a very limited way as he left the stadium.

“It doesn’t look good at all but we have to wait and see,” Arteta said. “They [the medics] are a bit concerned. A player who has to come off with a really sharp pain is never good news. Bukayo did not start the game against Lille last Tuesday, then he started at Nottingham Forest on Sunday and it happened very early in this game. The level of intensity that this game requires, as well, is something incredible.

“You could see it on Tuesday night, the PSG-Barcelona game, what happened [with players getting injured]. This is man-to-man for 96 minutes in every action. There’s no breathing. The stress, the quality, the intensity, the level that you need … it’s unbelievable. It’s the highest level. And those things happen, unfortunately.”

Arteta insisted that he wanted more than the draw. “We take it, although that doesn’t mean we are really happy about it as we prepared to win,” he said. “You could see that right from the beginning – the mindset, the purpose and the intention that the team has, to be very dominant, to come here and cause problems to Bayern. To press them and attack them. That’s certainly what we’ve done. We were the better team in the first 25 minutes, we got the goal … unfortunately we also got the injury of Bukayo, which was a big setback.

items.titleZh: “情况不太妙”：萨卡对阵拜仁慕尼黑时因伤离场，阿尔特塔表示担忧
items.summaryZh: 萨卡因大腿肌肉受伤被换下，阿尔特塔坦言情况不太妙。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔毫不掩饰他对布卡约·萨卡大腿肌肉受伤的担忧，这次受伤迫使萨卡在阿森纳客场2比2战平拜仁慕尼黑的欧冠比赛中离场，他表示这“一点也不乐观”。
主教练对球员们展现出的战斗精神感到高兴，德克兰·赖斯在第82分钟扳平比分，为球队赢得了应得的一分。此前，替补受伤萨卡登场的埃贝雷奇·埃泽为阿森纳首开纪录，随后哈里·凯恩成为全场焦点。这位拜仁前锋助攻阿方索·戴维斯扳平比分，随后又通过点球帮助球队反超。
萨卡的受伤给阿森纳带来了一个苦涩的夜晚。在与戴维斯的常规对抗后，他倒在草坪上，经过治疗后缓慢走下场。萨卡离开球场时，行动依然非常受限。
阿尔特塔表示：“情况一点也不乐观，但我们必须等待并观察。他们（医疗团队）有点担心。一个因剧烈疼痛而不得不下场的球员绝不是什么好消息。布卡约上周二对阵里尔的比赛没有首发，周日对阵诺丁汉森林时首发了，而在本场比赛一开始就发生了这种情况。这场比赛所需的强度也是难以置信的。”
“你可以在周二晚上巴黎圣日耳曼对阵巴塞罗那的比赛中看到发生了什么（球员受伤）。这是持续96分钟、每个动作都一对一的对抗。没有喘息的机会。压力、质量、强度、你所需要的水平……这简直难以置信。这是最高水平。不幸的是，这些事情还是发生了。”
阿尔特塔坚称他想要的不仅仅是平局。“我们接受这个结果，但这并不意味着我们真的很高兴，因为我们是为赢球做准备的，”他说。“你可以从一开始就看到——球队的心态、目标和意图，那就是占据绝对主导地位，来到这里给拜仁制造麻烦。去压迫他们，攻击他们。我们确实做到了。在前25分钟里我们是更好的一方，我们取得了进球……不幸的是，我们也遭遇了布卡约的受伤，这是一个巨大的打击。

items.titleEn: Bayern Munich 2-2 Arsenal: Champions League – as it happened
items.summaryEn: Declan Rice struck to earn Arsenal a point after Harry Kane scored from the spot, but Bukayo Saka’s early injury will be a concernThe teams are out! Bayern are in one of their all-red phases, while Arsenal are harking back to the early 90s with a blue version of the famous bruised banana. Vincent Kompany is in the house, by the way, having recovered from a virus that threatened to keep him in bed. And so is Germany boss Jurgen Klopp, in the stands flashing that smile and throwing his arm around the shoulder of another erstwhile Liverpool manager, Rafael Benitez. Everyone having a good time, it seems, and looking forward to this big showdown, including Arsenal fan Charles Antaki … well, kind of: “Pretty dismal, the fare served up in the game against Forest. But! Pundits have assured us that because Bayern are going to be on the attack, Arsenal will be free to entertain us with a dazzling
bodyEn: David Hytner was at the Allianz Arena tonight. Here’s his report. Thanks for reading this MBM.

Mikel Arteta speaks to TNT Sports. “Wow, what a game … that’s one of the highest levels we have played … the level of opposition and our level as well … two teams that wanted to attack and play … a fascinating game … we started the game incredibly well … then we lost Bukayo [Saka] who was having a great game … we had to adapt … in the second half the game was very even … they are a bit concerned [about Saka] … when a player has to come off with sharp pain it is never good news … we have to wait and see … Bayern batter every team … so I really value what the boys did tonight … it is special.”

As Kane departs the TNT interview booth, Declan Rice replaces him. “For me Kane is the clear winner [of the Ballon d’Or] … his numbers speak for themselves … the year he’s had has been remarkable … when you play with him, you realise how good he is … when you play against him, you realise how much of a pain it is … as a striker, to play that pass for that goal … he’s ridiculous … such a good player … so happy [to score] … I lost my runner and I was in on the goal … 2-2 was a good spectacle … we could have had more … we aren’t coming here to just sit … match them … go man to man … at times it’s tough … onto the next, we’ve got to keep going.”

Harry Kane gives TNT the Bayern perspective. “A little bit of disappointment … when we look at the whole 90 minutes the draw was a fair result … we had a good spell after we scored the first goal … we looked like the team that was going to win … we had a couple of moments when we could have killed the game but didn’t … we can’t be too disappointed … we take the point and move on … I’m proud of the way I executed the penalty … nice to get on the scoresheet and help the team … I always seem to get a penalty against Arsenal … overall feeling good … hopefully I can keep it up … we have to believe [we can win the Champions League] … we’re a strong enough team … we were missing some key players tonight … we play second in the league on Sunday [in fact third-place Freiburg] … you have to roll with it … try to improve as you go along … a demanding part of the schedule … it’d be a massive honour [to win the Ballon d’Or on Monday] … I’ve made it clear I don’t like to talk about myself but of course I know it’d be a massive achievement if it does happen … Monday could be a big evening for me personally … I’m looking forward to it … hopefully I can enjoy the day and evening on Monday!”
The Champions League table after matchday 3. Arsenal are in seventh spot as a result of all that; Bayern are down in 14th.

Harry Kane and Declan Rice embrace each other. The England team-mates in Full Respect mode after a to-and-fro tussle that ends with the spoils shared. It wasn’t a classic from first minute until last, but when both teams hit the heights, they really did so in style. In the first half, Martin Ødegaard and Kane took turns to set up goals with creamy, dreamy long passes from deep; Eberechi Eze and Alphonso Davies came up with the top-drawer finishes they deserved. Kane then earned and converted a spot kick that looked to have won the game for Bayern, until Viktor Gyökeres set up Rice for the late equaliser. Arsenal won’t be winning the league phase with a 100-percent record this time, but just like last season, they look like they’ll take some beating as their quest to finally land the big one goes on. Bayern meanwhile are Bayern; they’ll be there or there abouts, won’t they?
The whistle goes on a fair result.
90 min +2: Rice goes long, and Tah clears. That set-piece was a surprising non-event from Arsenal’s point of view.
90 min +1: Raya goes long. Timber picks up possession just to the left of the Bayern D, and aims a power curler towards the top left. Neuer is forced to tip over the bar. Rice to take the corner.
90 min: Diaz can’t continue. Ndiaye replaces him. There will be three additional minutes.
89 min: Diaz goes down with nobody around him. Laimer puts the ball out so his team-mate can get some medical attention.
87 min: The Bayern fans are still in good voice, especially impressive seeing their team haven’t given them much to sing about for a while. Arsenal look the more likely to find a winner.
85 min: Merino, who knows a thing or two about scoring late winners, comes on for Odegaard. Meanwhile for the hosts, Brown replaces Davies.

83 min: Gyökeres barrels after a long pass down the left and nearly gets the better of Upamecano. Nearly, not quite, the big defender doing just enough to hold the striker off. But Arsenal have their tails up now!

… but suddenly Arsenal spring into life, and score another fine goal! Gyokeres plays a cute ball round the corner for Rice down the inside-right channel. Rice bursts into the box and threads a powerful low drive through Neuer and into the bottom left!
81 min: Arsenal are hogging the ball without doing too much with it. Bayern holding their pose.
79 min: This has become rather scrappy. Arsenal won’t mind that at all. Bayern no longer in full flow.
77 min: Diaz picks up possession from Davies on the left-hand corner of the Arsenal box, and warms Raya’s palms with a next-to-no-backlift curler towards the bottom right. Fine play all round.
75 min: Bayern stroke it around patiently. Neither team seems willing to make a big move right now.
73 min: The pace drops. The Bayern fans are in good voice nonetheless.

71 min: Bischof steals the ball off Lewis-Skelley and feeds Kane, who in turn releases Davies down the left. Davies makes his way into the Arsenal box, but Madueke gets back on the cover to usher the ball out for a goal kick. Arsenal were in a bit of bother for second there, so they can be thankful to Madueke for his hard work, and to Kane for hesitating a little bit too much upon launching that counter.
69 min: … and Arsenal respond by replacing Guimaraes and Havertz with Gyökeres and Lewis-Skelly.
68 min: Bayern replace Saibari and Gnabry with Luis Diaz and Karl …

67 min: Odegaard curls the free kick into the mixer. Havartz tries to prod home from a mid a melee. He can’t do it. Bayern counter en masses, and Laimer creams a low drive inches wide of the left-hand post.
66 min: Eze one-twos with Havertz down the inside left and draws a foul from Laimer. A free kick, just outside the box to the left. Odegaard to take.
64 min: Bayern press, Bayern probe.
63 min: Raya is fouled as the corner comes in, and the pressure is off Arsenal. But Bayern are clearly in the mood for more. A big five-to-ten minutes coming up.

62 min: Davies jinks in from the left and should shoot. He overthinks it and is crowded out. That was a decent half-chance. But Bayern come again, Gnabry winning a corner down the right. Bischof to take.
Kane makes no mistake! A stuttered run-up. Then a whip into the top left, Raya having been sent the other way. Unstoppable, even if Raya had decided correctly.

60 min: A low cross from the right finds Kane on the edge of the box. Kane smacks a drive goalwards. Timber, sliding in with one arm up, pays the price for doing so, the ball hitting that arm. Penalty!

58 min: Bischof pings a diagonal towards Kane on the left-hand edge of the Arsenal D. Kane heads down to Davies, who can’t get to the ball in time for a shot. But no matter from Bayern’s perspective, because …
56 min: The first lull in a long while.

54 min: Eze enters the box and drops a shoulder to get past Laimer down the left. He shoots from a tight angle. There’s a melee, and the ball’s eventually hacked clear. Both defences creaking a bit, but holding firm at the moment.

52 min: Tah plays a long pass down the left to find Saibari, who enters the Arsenal box before scuffing his shot. Saibari’s got himself into some good positions tonight, only to … well, that’s a start, though, isn’t it?

50 min: … and now it’s Raya’s turn to make an outstanding stop! Gnabry crosses from the right. Upamecano powers a header goalwards; from point-blank range, Raya somehow parry-scoops away! Two of the finest saves you’ll see in a long while!

48 min: … but Arsenal have come back out with intent, too, and Eze wins the first corner since the restart with a dribble down the left. Rice hits it long. Guimaraes wins a header at the far stick, six yards out. He plants a downward header towards the bottom right. It’s surely a goal, but Neuer somehow shovels it up off the line, off the crossbar, and away. What a save! Not quite on the Banks-Pele level, but not far off!
46 min: Kane is quickly on the ball, nearly releasing Gnabry down the middle with a route-one pass. Gabriel is on point to intercept. So close to a super-fast start to the second half for the hosts.
Bayern get the second half started. They’ve made a change, switching out Minjae Kim for Jonathan Tah.
Half-time entertainment.
It took a while for his match to get going, but it was worth the wait. Odegaard to Eze was sensational; so was Kane to Davies. Good luck predicting the outcome of this.
45 min +1: Raya picks the corner without fuss.

45 min: Kane plays a cute pass round the corner to release Gnabry down the right. Davies is free on the left, but Gnabry opts to shoot from distance. Poor decision. His effort is deflected out for a corner, but Davies had Raya and the goal in his sights. There will be two additional minutes.

44 min: Davies is everywhere at the moment. He barrels down the left and earns Bayern a corner. Gnabry whips towards the near post, where Timber heads clear. Bayern have been much improved in the last few minutes; what a difference a goal makes.

42 min: Rice’s delivery skims off the top of Laimer’s head at the near post. The ball nearly loops into the bottom right. Calafiori tries to force it home, but can only ripple the side netting. Laimer gets away with a big one there, because for a couple of split seconds, that had own goal written all over it.
41 min: Kane shoots. Blocked. Arsenal counter. Eze crosses from the left. That’s deflected out for a corner. This isn’t going to end 1-1.

39 min: Kane is caught late by Konsa’s lunge on the halfway line. Bayern are gifted the advantage, but Davies and Gnabry aren’t able to combine as they barrel towards the Arsenal box. Rice gets in the road to nix the attack. Then Konsa goes into the book. Kane is not happy with his England team-mate.

37 min: That was a peach of a goal. What a finish! But what a pass! Good luck deciding which of the Odegaard-Eze and Kane-Davies combinations is the most outrageously good. You could spend all night debating it. The assists and finishes so far tonight have been from the top drawer.

… so having said that, they split Arsenal open with absurd ease! Another Kane pass from deep. Almost from the centre spot, he forensically rolls a pass down the inside-left channel to release Davies, who gets in ahead of last man Timber, opens his body upon reaching the edge of the box, and passes across Raya and into the bottom right!

items.summaryZh: 凯恩点射破门，德克兰·赖斯斩获绝平进球，阿森纳在客场与拜仁战成2-2平。
bodyZh: 大卫·海特纳今晚在安联球场为您带来现场报道。感谢阅读本场实时图文直播。

阿尔特塔接受TNT体育采访：“哇，多棒的一场比赛……这是我们踢过的最高水平比赛之一……对手的水平很高，我们的水平也很高……两支渴望进攻和比赛的球队……这是一场精彩绝伦的比赛……我们开局极其出色……随后我们失去了萨卡，他本来踢得很好……我们不得不进行调整……下半场比赛非常势均力敌……他们对萨卡的情况有点担心……当球员因剧烈疼痛离场时，这绝不是好消息……我们必须等待进一步观察……拜仁击败了所有对手……所以我非常看重今晚小伙子们的表现……这很特别。”

当凯恩离开TNT采访区时，德克兰·赖斯顶替了他的位置。“对我来说，凯恩是金球奖的明显赢家……他的数据说明了一切……他这一年非同寻常……当你和他一起踢球时，你会意识到他有多优秀……当你与他交手时，你会意识到他有多令人头疼……作为一名前锋，能送出那样的传球来助攻进球……他太不可思议了……非常优秀的球员……很高兴能进球……我甩开了防守球员并直接面对球门……2-2是一个不错的对决结果……我们本可以进更多球……我们来这里可不是为了死守……我们要与他们对位拼抢……有时这很艰难……接下来我们要继续前进。”

哈里·凯恩从拜仁的角度接受了TNT采访。“有一点失望……纵观整场90分钟，平局是一个公平的结果……我们在打进第一球后有一段很好的势头……我们看起来像是能赢下比赛的球队……我们有几次本可以杀死比赛但没有把握住的机会……我们不能太失望……我们接受这分然后继续前进……我为自己罚进点球的方式感到骄傲……很高兴能取得进球并帮助球队……我好像对阵阿森纳时总能罚点球……总体感觉不错……希望我能保持下去……我们必须相信我们可以赢得欧冠……我们是一支足够强大的球队……今晚我们缺少了一些关键球员……我们周日要在联赛客场对阵（实际上是排名第三的弗赖堡）……你必须顺其自然……在比赛中不断尝试改进……赛程很吃力……如果周一赢得金球奖将是巨大的荣誉……我已经明确表示过不喜欢谈论自己……但如果真的发生，我知道这将是巨大的成就……周一对我自己来说可能是一个重大的夜晚……我很期待……希望我能享受周一的那一天和夜晚！”
第三轮比赛结束后的欧冠积分榜。阿森纳因此排名第七；拜仁则跌至第14位。

哈里·赖斯和德克兰·赖斯互相拥抱。这两位英格兰队友在经历了一场互有攻守、以平局收场的激烈较量后，展现出了十足的尊重。比赛并非从第一分钟到最后一分钟都堪称经典，但当两支球队展现出巅峰状态时，确实极具风格。在上半场，厄德高和凯恩通过精妙的后场长传轮流助攻破门；埃泽和阿方索·戴维斯则完成了他们应得的顶级射门。随后，凯恩创造并罚入点球，这似乎为拜仁赢得了比赛，直到哲凯赖什助攻赖斯完成了晚期绝平。阿森纳这次无法以全胜战绩赢得联赛阶段，但就像上赛季一样，在他们继续追逐最终大奖的征程中，他们看起来依然很难被击败。而拜仁终究是拜仁；他们总会名列前茅的，不是吗？
裁判吹响了比赛结束的哨音，这是一个公平的结果。
第90+2分钟：赖斯送出长传，若纳坦·塔将球解围。从阿森纳的角度来看，这次定位球战术令人意外地毫无建树。
第90+1分钟：拉亚送出长传。廷贝尔在拜仁禁区弧顶左侧得球，随后起脚兜出一记极具威胁的弧线球直奔球门右上角。诺伊尔被迫将球托出横梁。由赖斯主罚角球。
第90分钟：迪亚斯无法坚持比赛，恩迪亚耶替补登场。比赛将补时三分钟。
第89分钟：迪亚斯在无人逼抢的情况下倒地。莱默将球踢出边线，以便让队友接受队医治疗。
第87分钟：拜仁球迷依然在大声歌唱，考虑到他们的球队有一段时间没能为他们带来值得歌颂的表现，这尤其令人印象深刻。阿森纳看起来更有可能攻入制胜球。
第85分钟：梅里诺换下厄德高，他对于如何打入制胜球略知一二。与此同时，主队方面，布朗替补登场换下戴维斯。
第83分钟：哲凯赖什沿着左路追赶一记长传，险些过掉于帕梅卡诺。险些成功但差了一点，这位高大中后卫做出了足够精妙的防守挡住了前锋。但阿森纳现在士气正盛！
……但阿森纳突然爆发，再次打进一记精彩进球！哲凯赖什在右肋部巧妙分球给前插的赖斯。赖斯杀入禁区，大力低射穿过诺伊尔的防守直奔球门左下角！
第81分钟：阿森纳长时间控球，但并未创造出太多实质威胁。拜仁稳守阵型。
第79分钟：比赛变得有些零碎。阿森纳对此求之不得。拜仁不再处于流畅的进攻节奏中。
第77分钟：迪亚斯在阿森纳禁区左角接阿方索·戴维斯传球，随即起脚兜射直奔球门右下角，几乎没有做多余的摆腿动作，考验了拉亚的扑救能力。整体配合相当精彩。
第75分钟：拜仁耐心倒脚。目前双方似乎都不愿贸然大举压上。
第73分钟：比赛节奏下降。尽管如此，拜仁球迷仍在激情高歌。
第71分钟：比肖夫从刘易斯-斯凯利脚下断球并分给凯恩，凯恩随即将球分给左路的戴维斯。戴维斯突入阿森纳禁区，但马杜埃凯回防及时将球解围出底线。阿森纳刚刚陷入了一点小麻烦，他们得感谢马杜埃凯的努力防守，以及凯恩在策动反击时稍微犹豫了一下。
第69分钟：……阿森纳随即做出调整，用哲凯赖什和刘易斯-斯凯利换下了吉马良斯和哈弗茨。
第68分钟：拜仁用路易斯·迪亚斯和卡尔换下了萨伊巴里和格纳布里……
第67分钟：厄德高将任意球吊入禁区混战之中。哈弗茨在人群中试图捅射破门，但未能成功。拜仁随后发起集体反击，莱默的低射擦着左侧立柱偏出几英寸。
第66分钟：埃泽在左肋部与哈弗茨做出撞墙配合，迫使莱默犯规。获得禁区外左侧的任意球机会。由厄德高主罚。
第64分钟：拜仁持续施压，寻找战机。
第63分钟：在角球开出时拉亚遭到犯规，阿森纳的防守压力得以解除。但拜仁显然还想要更多进球。接下来将是至关重要的五到十分钟。
第62分钟：戴维斯从左路内切本该直接射门，但他思考过多导致防守球员合围上来错失良机。这是一次不错的半单刀机会。但拜仁卷土重来，格纳布里在右路赢得一个角球。由比肖夫主罚。
凯恩稳稳罚进！他助跑时略有停顿。随后起脚抽射直奔球门右上角，拉亚被骗向另一侧。即使拉亚判断对了方向也根本无力阻挡。
第60分钟：右路送出低平传中，凯恩在禁区边缘得球。凯恩直接起脚怒射攻门。滑铲封堵的廷贝尔单臂抬起付出了代价，皮球击中了手臂。点球！
第58分钟：比肖夫斜传找到阿森纳禁区弧顶左侧的凯恩。凯恩头球摆渡给戴维斯，但后者未能及时赶到完成射门。不过从拜仁的角度来看这并不重要，因为……
第56分钟：比赛迎来了许久以来的首次平静期。
第54分钟：埃泽突入禁区，沉肩晃过左路的莱默。他在小角度起脚射门。禁区内一片混战，皮球最终被大脚解围。双方防线都有所动摇，但目前仍算稳固。
第52分钟：若纳坦·塔送出左路长传找到萨伊巴里，后者突入阿森纳禁区后仓促射门未能踢正部位。萨伊巴里今晚多次跑出好位置，但……好吧，这算是一个开始，不是吗？
第50分钟：……现在轮到拉亚做出神级扑救了！格纳布里右路传中，于帕梅卡诺强力头球攻门；在近距离面对面的情况下，拉亚竟然神奇地将球挡出！这是你许久不见的两次顶级神扑！
第48分钟：……但阿森纳卷土重来同样气势汹汹，埃泽通过左路带球突破赢得了下半场开场以来的首个角球。赖斯送出长传，吉马良斯在后点六码处争顶成功，他将球顶向球门右下角。这本该是个必进球，但诺伊尔竟然神奇地在门线前将球挡起，击中横梁弹开。多么精彩的扑救！虽然还比不上班克斯对贝利的那次神扑，但也相差不远了！
第46分钟：凯恩迅速得球，险些通过一脚直塞球在中路连线格纳布里。加布里埃尔及时到位完成拦截。主队下半场的闪击战险些成功。
拜仁开出下半场比赛。他们做出人员调整，用若纳坦·塔换下了金玟哉。
中场休息娱乐时间。
这场比赛虽然花了点时间才进入状态，但等待是值得的。厄德高助攻埃泽的配合妙到巅毫；凯恩助攻戴维斯的配合同样如此。想要预测比赛结果全凭运气。
第45+1分钟：拉亚轻松没收角球。
第45分钟：凯恩巧妙分球给右路的格纳布里。虽然左路的戴维斯处于无人防守状态，但格纳布里选择从远处直接射门，这是个糟糕的决定。他的射门被封堵出底线获得角球，而戴维斯本已瞄准了拉亚和空门。比赛将补时两分钟。
第44分钟：戴维斯此刻无处不在。他沿左路强行突破为拜仁赢得一个角球。格纳布里主罚传向近门柱，廷贝尔头球解围。拜仁在过去几分钟里有了显著改善；一个进球带来的改变太大了。
第42分钟：赖斯的传球擦着莱默在近门柱的头顶飞过。皮球险些划出弧线飞入球门右下角。卡拉菲奥里试图补射，但只能击中边网。莱默这次逃过一劫，因为在短短几分之一秒里，这球看起来活脱脱就是一个乌龙球。
第41分钟：凯恩起脚射门被封堵。阿森纳发起反击，埃泽从左路传中被封堵出底线获得角球。这场比赛绝对不会以1-1收场。
第39分钟：中线附近孔萨飞铲放倒了启动稍慢的凯恩。拜仁获得进攻优势，但戴维斯和格纳布里在推进至阿森纳禁区时未能形成配合。赖斯及时回防化解了这次进攻。随后孔萨吃到黄牌。凯恩对这位英格兰国家队队友的动作很不满意。
第37分钟：这是一记无与伦比的精妙进球。多棒的射门！但这传球更是绝妙！要想评选出厄德高连线埃泽与凯恩连线戴维斯究竟哪一组配合更加离谱般地精彩，简直是不可能的任务。你可以花上一整晚来讨论它。今晚到目前为止的助攻和射门堪称顶级水准。
……话虽如此，他们极其荒谬地轻易撕开了阿森纳的防线！又是一脚来自凯恩的后场长传。几乎从中圈弧开始，他精准地将球顺到左肋部通道，释放了前插的戴维斯。戴维斯抢在最后一名防守队员廷贝尔之前得球，在杀入禁区边缘时舒展身体，推射穿过拉亚的防守钻入球门右下角！

bodyEn: It is as if Harry Kane cannot get enough of tormenting Arsenal. The Bayern Munich striker has plenty of form from his Tottenham days. He remains the top scorer in north London derby history with 14 goals. He made an impact yet again here and yet it was not a night when he had the final word. That honour fell to Declan Rice, the Arsenal midfielder storming into the Bayern area in the 82nd minute to guide home a low finish that Kane would have been proud to call his own.

Arsenal were hunting their latest statement result. Only once had they ever won away against Bayern – the 2-0 in the Champions League last 16 second leg in 2013, although it did not prevent an away goals exit. Mikel Arteta was an Arsenal player that night. When Eberechi Eze, who came on for the injured Bukayo Saka in the 10th minute, gave them the lead midway through the first half, their hopes surged.

Enter Kane. He wore his playmaker’s hat; some of his passing was sumptuous and it was his assist for Alphonso Davies that helped Bayern to draw level. He wore his finisher’s one, too, scoring from the penalty spot to put his team in charge. It meant he had scored in 10 consecutive Champions League games; one short of Cristiano Ronaldo’s record. There is a reason why Kane is the favourite to win the Ballon d’Or on Monday. He now has 16 goals against Arsenal; he has only scored more against one club – Leicester, against whom he has 20.

Rice loosened Bayern’s grip. It was a lovely goal from him and Arsenal even hinted at a late winner, Jurriën Timber drawing a tip over from Manuel Neuer in stoppage time. That would have been too much because Bayern shaded an absorbing tie in terms of clear chances created. But Arsenal made their point. They were value for it.

Arsenal knew they were inside a fortress. Bayern had not previously lost a Champions League group or league phase match at their own stadium since the 3-2 reverse against Manchester City in December 2013, 40 games ago. The following 39 featured 37 wins and two draws. Arteta’s players were not intimidated. They bristled with assurance at the outset and Rice rewarded their never-say-die spirit. Bayern had wanted revenge for their 3-1 defeat at the Emirates Stadium in the league stage last season. They did not get it.

Arteta’s idea was to go pretty much as strong as possible with his lineup. He made just two changes, Timber for Ben White and Noni Madueke for Eze, albeit the latter was not on the bench for long. Saka had tussled with Davies and it looked innocuous. The alarm bells rang when Saka grabbed his thigh and went to ground, waving his hand in the air.

Was it possible for the Arsenal support to think that Bayern had been stripped of their fear factor in the line behind Kane? Michael Olise was suspended, Jamal Musiala was injured and Luis Díaz was a substitute. He came on in the 68th minute only to be forced off before the end. Bayern were without the midfielder Joshua Kimmich for personal reasons.

Arteta moved Madueke over to his more natural position on the right wing when he introduced Eze on the left and Bayern will still be wondering how the latter was afforded so much space up the inside channel on that flank to put Arsenal in front.

It was a fabulous ball from Martin Ødegaard, who was in the mood, full of sharp turns and urgency, and Eze had the time to let it bounce before shooting first time into the far corner. An offside flag killed the Arsenal celebrations and there was one of those weird waits before the video assistant referee ruled that Eze was in fact onside.

Kane was booed by the Arsenal fans. Of course he was. He dropped deep to link the play and there was a moment in the 17th minute when he started a move with a pass from inside his own penalty area. There was a glorious ping over Gabriel Magalhães, who was the last Arsenal defender, for Ismael Saibari on 23 minutes, although his teammate could not control, and Kane’s fingerprints were all over the equaliser. He was on halfway when he sculpted the low through ball for Davies which took Timber out of the equation. The Bayern winger’s finish was clinical.

Bayern had other chances in the first half, none better than the one for Serge Gnabry, the former Arsenal winger, in the 21st minute. It was Kane who began the attack, taking a quick goal kick – yes, really – and Gnabry was the man over on the right when the Bayern forwards worked it that way. Gnabry’s shot was too close to David Raya. Kane also saw Ezri Konsa produce a fine block to keep him out.

It is never anything other than a pleasure to be at the Allianz for a showpiece match. All the staples were present and correct. The en masse scarf waving. The slightly slapstick oompah band notes. The fans at either end of the ground calling to each other. The non-stop drumbeat and songs from the Südkurve, who also bounced as one at times.

The pre-game surprise had been the sight of Vincent Kompany in the Bayern dugout; the manager made a Lazarus-like rise from his sickbed and the action after the restart kept the blood pumping. Arsenal thought they had gone back ahead when Bruno Guimarães rose to meet Rice’s corner only for Neuer to produce an extraordinary save.

The goalkeeper touched the ball up and on to the crossbar and away. Shades of Gordon Banks against Pelé. It was Raya’s turn next; his save to keep out Dayot Upamecano’s close-range header from Gnabry’s cross was of the highest order.

It was interesting to watch Kane after the penalty was awarded for handball against Timber. Bayern had worked the ball back to their No 9 and, when he shot, Timber’s arm was outstretched. Kane went through his mental processes. He could see that Raya did not retreat to his line for what felt like an age. Kane delayed even longer. He was in total control. He stuttered before banging the ball hard into Raya’s right-hand corner.

Bayern were close to putting the game to bed. Konrad Laimer dragged narrowly past the far post when well-placed but it was Arsenal who produced the sucker punch. Eze was dangerous throughout. And when the opportunity knocked for Rice after a pass from the substitute Viktor Gyökeres, he made no mistake.

items.titleZh: 德克兰·赖斯斩获绝平进球，阿森纳客场战平拜仁慕尼黑
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳客场战平拜仁慕尼黑，赖斯攻入关键绝平球。
bodyZh: 哈里·凯恩似乎永远无法停止对阿森纳的折磨。这位拜仁慕尼黑前锋在热刺时期便状态火热，目前以14个进球保持着北伦敦德比历史射手王的纪录。在这里，他再次制造了威胁，但这并非属于他一锤定音的夜晚。这份荣耀属于德克兰·赖斯，这位阿森纳中场在第82分钟杀入拜仁禁区，打入了一脚低射，这样的射门凯恩自己也会引以为豪。
阿森纳渴望延续近期的出色战绩。他们此前在客场对阵拜仁仅赢过一次——即2013年欧冠16强淘汰赛次回合2比0取胜，尽管那场胜利未能阻止他们因客场进球劣势出局。米克尔·阿尔特塔当晚作为球员代表阿森纳出场。比赛进行到上半场中段，替补受伤的布卡约·萨卡登场的埃贝雷奇·埃泽为阿森纳取得领先，他们的希望随之高涨。
凯恩登场了。他扮演了组织核心的角色，送出了一些精妙绝伦的传球，正是他为阿森纳扳平比分的阿尔方索·戴维斯送上了助攻。他也展现了终结者的本色，通过点球破门帮助球队反超比分。这意味着他在连续10场欧冠比赛中都有进球，距离克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多的纪录仅差一场。凯恩成为周一金球奖热门人选是有原因的。他目前对阵阿森纳已攻入16球；他进球更多的只有莱斯特城一家俱乐部，达到了20球。
赖斯削弱了拜仁的控制力。他的进球非常精彩，阿森纳甚至在比赛尾声险些绝杀，尤里伦·廷贝尔在伤停补时阶段的射门被曼努埃尔·诺伊尔神勇扑出。考虑到拜仁在绝对创造机会方面略占优势，若真绝杀或许略显夸张。但阿森纳证明了自己，他们的表现配得上这个结果。
阿森纳深知自己踏入了一座堡垒。自2013年12月以2比3不敌曼城以来，拜仁在此前40场欧冠小组赛或联赛阶段的主场比赛中从未尝过败绩。随后的39场比赛中，他们取得了37胜2平的战绩。阿尔特塔的球员们并没有被吓倒。他们在开局时便充满了自信，赖斯用表现回报了他们永不言弃的精神。拜仁此前曾希望为上赛季在联赛阶段酋长球场1比3的失利复仇，但他们未能如愿。
阿尔特塔的战术是尽可能排出最强首发阵容。他仅做出了两处调整，廷贝尔顶替本·怀特，诺尼·马杜埃凯顶替埃泽，尽管后者并未在替补席上待多久。萨卡曾与戴维斯发生身体对抗，当时看似并无大碍。直到萨卡捂住大腿倒地并挥手示意时，警报骤然拉响。
阿森纳球迷是否会认为拜仁在凯恩身后的支持线上缺少了令人恐惧的因素？迈克尔·奥利斯停赛，贾马尔·穆西亚拉受伤，路易斯·迪亚斯则坐在替补席上。迪亚斯在第68分钟替补登场，但在比赛结束前便被迫离场。拜仁由于个人原因缺少了中场约书亚·基米希。
当阿尔特塔换上埃泽并将其安排在左翼时，他将马杜埃凯调回了更熟悉的右边锋位置，而拜仁至今可能仍在纳闷，为什么在那个内侧通道会给埃泽留下如此巨大的空间，从而让阿森纳取得领先。
这是一脚来自马丁·厄德高的绝妙传球，当时他状态正佳，充满了犀利的转身和极强的战术执行力，埃泽有充足的时间让球弹地一次，随后直接起脚抽射远角破门。越位旗帜曾短暂扼杀了阿森纳的庆祝，在经历了一段诡异的等待后，视频助理裁判裁定埃泽并未越位。
凯恩遭到了阿森纳球迷的嘘声，这是意料之中的事。他回撤很深参与串联，比赛第17分钟时，他曾在本方禁区内通过一次传球策动进攻。第23分钟，他向加布里埃尔·马加良斯身侧送出了一记精彩的长传，但伊斯梅尔·赛巴里未能停好皮球，而凯恩对扳平进球居功至伟。当时他站在中线附近，送出一记低平直塞撕开了廷贝尔的防守，拜仁边锋的射门干净利落。
拜仁在上半场还有其他机会，其中最好的机会出现在第21分钟，属于前阿森纳边锋塞尔日·格纳布里。进攻正是由凯恩通过一次快速球门球发起的——没错，确实如此，当拜仁前锋将球打到右路时，格纳布里成为了接应点。可惜格纳布里的射门角度太正，被大卫·雷亚没收。凯恩的另一次射门也被埃兹里·孔萨神勇封堵。

推广后
在安联球场观看一场重磅对决永远是一种享受。所有的传统元素都悉数呈现。大规模的挥舞围巾，略带滑稽的铜管乐队音符，球场两端球迷的互相对喊。南看台不间断的鼓点和歌声，有时他们还会整齐划一地跳跃。
赛前的惊喜是文森特·孔帕尼出现在了拜仁的教练席上；这位主帅犹如“拉撒路复活”般从病榻上起身，比赛重新开始后的激烈对决让血液沸腾。阿森纳曾以为他们通过布鲁诺·吉马良斯接应赖斯的角球头球破门反超了比分，但诺伊尔做出了一次不可思议的扑救。
这位门将将球托击并碰在横梁上弹开。这令人想起了当年戈登·班克斯扑出贝利头球的经典一幕。接下来轮到了雷亚表演；他将格纳布里传中后达约特·于帕梅卡诺近距离的头球攻门神勇化解，堪称世界级扑救。
有趣的是，在因廷贝尔手球被判点球后，观察凯恩的反应。拜仁将球回传给他们的9号球员，当他起脚射门时，廷贝尔的手臂伸展开了。凯恩在脑海中进行着心理博弈。他看到雷亚迟迟没有退回门线。凯恩进一步拖延了时间。他完全掌控了节奏。他在助跑时略作顿挫，随后将球狠狠轰入雷亚的右下角。
拜仁险些杀死比赛悬念。康拉德·莱默尔在绝佳位置的射门擦着远门柱偏出，但最终完成致命一击的是阿森纳。埃泽整场比赛都极具威胁。当替补登场的维克托·哲凯赖什送出传球，赖斯迎来良机时，他没有浪费机会稳稳命中。
